title: Senior Associate Security Platform Engineer
description:

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Senior Associate Security Platform Engineer is a developing subject matter expert, responsible for facilitating problem resolution and mentoring for the overall team.
  
  
This role performs operational security tasks such as performance and availability monitoring, log monitoring, security incident detection and response, security event reporting, and content maintenance (tuning).
  
  
The Senior Associate Security Platform Engineer is responsible for detecting and monitoring escalated threats and suspicious activity affecting the organization's technology domain (servers, networks, appliances and all infrastructure supporting production applications for the enterprise, as well as development environments).
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Works as part of a 24/7 team working on rotational shifts.
* Works as part of Platform and Content Engineering handling tunings, stake holder requests, escalations, reporting, trainings.
* Administers the organization's security tools to gather security logs from environment.
* Lifecycle management of the supported security tools/technologies, Break-fix, Patching, Live update.
* Adheres to SOPs and notify stake holders on log flow/log format issues.
* Documents best practices.
* Identifies opportunities to make automations which will help the incident response team.
* Performs security incident handling and response from several vectors including End Point Protection and Enterprise Detection and response tools, attack analysis, malware analysis, network forensics, computer forensics, and a broad range of skills in LAN technologies, Windows and Linux O/S’s, and general security infrastructure.
* Carries out agreed maintenance tasks.
* Ensures usage of knowledge articles in incident diagnosis and resolution and assist with updating as and when required.
* Performs defined tasks to monitor service delivery against service level agreements and maintains records of relevant information.
* Investigates causes of incidents and seeks resolution.
* Escalates unresolved incidents and follow up until incident is resolved.
* Provides service recovery, following resolution of incidents.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Knowledge on security architecture, worked across different security technologies.
* Customer service orientated and pro-active thinking.
* Problem solver who is highly driven and self-organized.

* Good analytical and logical thinking.
* Excellent spoken and written communication skills.

* Moderate level experience in technical support to clients.
* Moderate level experience in diagnosis and troubleshooting.
* Moderate level experience providing remote support in Security Technologies.
* Moderate level experience in SOC/CSIRT Operations.
* Moderate level experience in handling security incidents end to end.
* Knowledge on networking, Linux and security concepts.
* Moderate level experience in configuring/managing security controls such as Firewall, IDS/IPS, EDR, NDR, UTM, Proxy, SOAR, HoneyPots and other security tools.

description:
Vulnerability Management

5+ Years

Vulnerability Management

We are looking for an experienced Vulnerability Management and Security Compliance professional with strong knowledge of vulnerability assessment, remediation, security hardening, and compliance standards, including CIS Benchmarks and DISA STIGs. The candidate will be responsible for identifying security vulnerabilities, assessing risks, coordinating remediation activities, and ensuring compliance with established security baselines across enterprise IT infrastructure.

* Apply and validate security configurations based on

  and
  **DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs)**
  .
* Conduct security configuration assessments and system hardening for Windows and Linux environments.
* Work with infrastructure, application, and operations teams to remediate vulnerabilities within defined SLAs.
* Analyze vulnerability findings based on CVSS scores, severity, exploitability, and business risk.
* Support security compliance audits, baseline assessments, and remediation of configuration deviations.
* Generate vulnerability assessment reports, compliance dashboards, risk summaries, and remediation status reports.
* Support exception management, risk acceptance documentation, and compensating control assessments.
* Collaborate with security operations and infrastructure teams to improve security posture and reduce recurring vulnerabilities.
* Maintain security documentation, compliance evidence, and remediation records.

Required Skills

  **5+ years of experience**

* Experience with security baseline validation, compliance gap analysis, and remediation tracking.
* Familiarity with operating system security controls, patch management, and configuration management.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.

title: Infrastructure Security Specialist
description:
**Role Purpose**
The On-Premises Security Engineer is responsible for protecting enterprise data center infrastructure, with specialized ownership of security engineering for VMware vSphere, vCenter Server, ESXi hosts, virtual machines, and the supporting identity, network, storage, backup, logging, and management services. The role establishes and maintains secure configurations, monitors for threats and control failures, drives vulnerability remediation, supports incident response, and provides security guidance throughout the infrastructure lifecycle.
  
  
Working closely with On-Premises Operations, Security Operations, Infrastructure Engineering, Network, Storage, Backup, R&D, QA, Compliance, and corporate IT teams, the engineer converts security requirements into practical, supportable controls that protect availability, integrity, confidentiality, and recoverability without introducing unnecessary operational risk.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**VMware Platform Security Engineering/ On-Premises Infrastructure Security**

* Design, implement, maintain, and continuously improve security controls for VMware vSphere, vCenter Server Appliance, ESXi hosts, clusters, virtual machines, templates, datastores, management networks, and virtual networking.
* Develop and enforce secure configuration baselines for ESXi and vCenter, including lockdown mode, Secure Boot, TPM attestation, host firewall rules, SSH and shell restrictions, certificate management, time synchronization, persistent logging, and control-state monitoring.
* Assess VMware architecture and configuration changes for security impact; document requirements, risks, exceptions, compensating controls, validation steps, and rollback considerations.
* Partner with platform owners on lifecycle management, patching, upgrades, certificate renewal, version supportability, hardware refresh, and secure decommissioning.

**Identity, Access, and Privileged Administration**

* Implement and review least-privilege access, role-based access control, separation of duties, privileged access workflows, service accounts, and administrative group membership across VMware management services.
* Secure vCenter Single Sign-On and connected identity sources, including Active Directory or federated identity integrations; review authentication, authorization, and privileged activity for anomalous or unauthorized behavior.
* Coordinate periodic access reviews and provide evidence for audit, compliance, and control-assurance activities.

**Vulnerability and Configuration Management**

* Perform or coordinate vulnerability assessments, configuration reviews, and security testing across hypervisors, management appliances, guest operating systems, and supporting infrastructure.
* Analyze vendor advisories, CVEs, scan results, and threat intelligence; prioritize remediation based on exploitability, exposure, asset criticality, operational risk, and available compensating controls.
* Track remediation through closure, validate corrective actions, and document accepted risks or approved exceptions in accordance with governance requirements.
* Coordinate operating system and application hardening for Windows and Linux virtual machines using approved enterprise standards.

**Security Monitoring, Detection, and Incident Response**

* Integrate VMware and supporting infrastructure telemetry with the enterprise SIEM and security monitoring ecosystem; ensure security-relevant events are collected, normalized, retained, and usable for investigation.
* Develop and tune detection use cases for authentication anomalies, privilege escalation, unauthorized configuration changes, control tampering, suspicious VM lifecycle activity, persistence, destructive actions, backup interference, and ransomware indicators.
* Monitor security alerts and infrastructure logs; investigate anomalous activity, preserve evidence, determine scope and impact, and coordinate containment, eradication, and recovery with Security Operations and infrastructure teams.
* Lead or support root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews; translate lessons learned into corrective actions, improved detections, updated baselines, and stronger operational procedures.

**Data Center Consolidation & Migration Security**

* Provide security engineering and assurance throughout data-center consolidation and workload migration activities, including pre-migration risk assessments, target-state security requirements, migration validation, and post-migration control verification.
* Validate that security controls, logging, endpoint protection, network segmentation, privileged access, vulnerability management, backup/recovery, and monitoring remain effective before, during, and after workload migrations.
* Identify legacy dependencies, unsupported platforms, security-control gaps, and technical debt that could introduce risk during migration, and track remediation or approved exceptions through closure.
* Work with relevant stakeholders across security, technology, and business functions to establish security requirements and validate migrated workloads.

**Resilience, Recovery, and Operational Assurance**

* Validate that VMware security controls align with backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity requirements, including administrative isolation and recoverability of critical workloads.
* Participate in recovery testing, tabletop exercises, security validation, and major infrastructure changes; document findings and track corrective actions.
* Create dashboards, metrics, and reporting for vulnerability exposure, configuration compliance, privileged access, logging coverage, remediation status, exceptions, and security control health.
* Maintain technical standards, procedures, runbooks, architecture diagrams, control evidence, and operational documentation.

**Collaboration and Governance**

* Provide security subject-matter expertise to infrastructure, engineering, application, compliance, and business teams on secure on-premises architecture and VMware operations.
* Contribute to security roadmaps, platform modernization, technical proposals, design reviews, audit responses, risk assessments, and policy or standard development.
* Communicate technical risks and recommended actions clearly to both technical teams and leadership; escalate material risks, control failures, and unresolved remediation issues through established governance channels.
* Participate in an on-call or incident-response rotation as required by the operating model.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in information security, infrastructure security, systems engineering, or data center operations, including substantial experience securing VMware environments.
* Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere, vCenter Server, ESXi, clusters, virtual networking, datastores, permissions, certificates, logging, patching, and lifecycle management.
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure security principles, including system hardening, vulnerability management, privileged access, network segmentation, encryption, logging, monitoring, incident response, backup security, and disaster recovery.
* Experience securing Windows Server and Linux systems and working with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, PKI/certificates, enterprise networking, firewalls, load balancers, shared storage, and backup platforms.
* Experience with SIEM, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, configuration compliance, and security incident-management tools.
* Ability to interpret technical logs and security alerts, perform structured troubleshooting, collect defensible evidence, assess risk, and coordinate remediation across multiple teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, disciplined documentation practices, and the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike, or a comparable SIEM, including log onboarding, use-case development, detection tuning, dashboards, and incident investigation.
* Experience with PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar scripting and automation technologies.
* Knowledge of CIS Benchmarks, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, MITRE ATT&CK, CVSS, and risk-based control assessment.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, Security+, VMware VCP or VCAP, or comparable infrastructure and security credentials.
* Experience supporting regulated, validated, or audit-sensitive environments.

**Technical Knowledge Areas**
**VMware Security**

* vSphere, vCenter Server, ESXi, HA/DRS concepts, permissions, SSO, certificates, Secure Boot, TPM, lockdown mode, host firewall, logging, patching, hardening, and lifecycle security.

**Identity & Access**

* Active Directory, federation concepts, RBAC, least privilege, privileged access, service accounts, access reviews, authentication, and authorization monitoring.

**Infrastructure**

* Windows Server, Linux, server hardware, shared storage, backup and recovery, PKI, DNS/DHCP, VLANs, routing, load balancers, firewalls, and management networks.

**Security Operations**

* SIEM, event correlation, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, threat detection, incident response, evidence preservation, root-cause analysis, and remediation tracking.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Security standards, risk assessments, control testing, exceptions, audit evidence, metrics, policy implementation, and technical documentation.

**Automation**

* PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Bash, APIs, configuration validation, reporting automation, and repeatable security control checks.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Security ownership and sound judgment, with the ability to balance risk reduction, service availability, and operational practicality.
* Analytical troubleshooting and disciplined decision-making during high-impact security or infrastructure incidents.
* Attention to detail in production changes, access control, evidence collection, remediation validation, and technical documentation.
* Clear, respectful communication and effective collaboration across security, infrastructure, engineering, compliance, and vendor teams.
* Continuous-improvement mindset with a focus on automation, measurable controls, resilience, and reduction of recurring risk.
* Ability to work independently, manage concurrent priorities, and operate effectively across regions and time zones

**Key Accountabilities**
**Strategic**

* Advance the VMware and on-premises security roadmap, architecture, lifecycle, and modernization priorities.

**Operational**

* Maintain secure operations, investigate incidents, reduce vulnerabilities, validate changes, and support reliable recovery.

**Assurance**

* Measure control effectiveness, maintain evidence, report risk and remediation status, and support audits and compliance reviews.

title: Manager, Technology Risk Management
description:
Your opportunity
  
  
At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
  
  
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
  
  
The Cyber Assessments and Resilience Team is a first line of defense team positioned within the Schwab Cybersecurity Services vertical, aligned to ensure that services and applications within the Schwab Portfolio are assessed from a technology risk, cybersecurity risk, and cyber resilience perspective.
  
  
The cybersecurity risk assessor is a subject matter expert (SME) who works as part of the team to assess cybersecurity risks against established requirements, standards, policies and frameworks. The individual is responsible for proactive identification, assessment, treatment, and continuous monitoring of information security and technology risks. As a risk assessment SME, the individual reviews cybersecurity practices and recommends remediation of gaps or proposes new controls, consistent with best practices, as well as continually evaluates risk exposure and tolerance as defined by business leaders and external entities. The role also reviews and documents deficiencies, advocates for change and, when appropriate, escalates issues to senior risk leadership.
  
  
This is a key role in assuring that cyber risks are effectively managed, Schwab client information is protected, and our client’s trust is maintained. Success in this role will require ability to exercise influence, communicate effectively, think strategically, and work collaboratively among internal and external stakeholders across multiple functions combined with strong expertise in risk management discipline and security and technology controls best practices. This is an individual contributor role.
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Receive and triage new assessment requests relating to on-prem, public cloud, third party, acquired applications, processes, and standards. Review inherent risk characteristics and validate the inherent risk is accurate to prepare for assessment.
* Partner with a distributed team consisting of security architects, engineers, and risk practitioners to determine the assessment scope and rigor based on inherent risk
* Maintain coordination and organization of assessments in flight between all key security teams involved throughout the lifecycle of the assessment.
* Translate control gaps identified from security architecture and engineering teams into security conditions and documented issues in a risk-based language that can be shared with application and system owners for remediation.
* Coordinate with application and technology teams and explain gaps which need actioning prior to production release, while communicating risks identified by assessment up to senior management.
* Document effectiveness of the application/system, process, or third party and the residual risk resulting from the assessment.
* Prepare a detailed cybersecurity risk assessment report based on existing risk reporting models and templates.
* Perform continuous monitoring and tracking of identified gaps and provide regular risk updates to senior management
* Create and present risk posture discovery and recommendation reports to risk management leadership.
* Develop and deliver executive-level reporting and presentations outlining cyber risks, risk velocity/trending, and status of defined action plans.
* Identify and manage continuous improvements in various areas, including automation of risk assessments, leadership reporting activities, development and maintenance of risk-related information, and audit and/or regulatory areas.
* Contribute to the creation and ongoing development of security and control metrics.
* Support maturing cyber risk governance through development of standard processes and procedures.
* Advocate and promote awareness of cyber risks to business and technical partners.

**Other Responsibilities Include**

* Build strong relationships and partner closely with security and technology partners across Charles Schwab Corporation and its affiliates.
* Develop internal processes to increase team efficiencies and continually mature operations.
* Other risk related responsibilities as identified
* May travel minimally as needed

**Required Experience**

* 3-5 years of relevant experience in the disciplines of information security, risk assessment activities or information security compliance with strong hands-on experience in security risk assessments.
* Superior attention to detail and focus on quality work delivery
* Expertise in information security best practices and technology risk management disciplines, including knowledge and familiarity with a broad range of IT and information security products and technologies such as Network Security, Cryptography, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Logging and Monitoring, Cloud Platforms, and Application Security.
* Familiar with one or more regulatory requirements and laws such as, but not limited to, PCI, Federal Financial Institutions Examinations Council, Sarbanes-Oxley Act, HIPAA, GDPR and GLBA. Additionally, experience in one or more: ISO 27001, ITIL and NIST. General understanding of the Factor Analysis of Information Risk methodology
* Working knowledge of software development practices and technologies.
* Understanding of information security or technology risks.
* Experience in developing performance or risk metrics, and executive dashboards.
* Excellent analytical & technical skills, able to research problems, determine root causes and solutions.
* Experience using and administering collaboration platforms such as MS SharePoint, Confluence, or JIRA.
* Must be a self-starter and able to work independently, as part of a team, and lead working groups as required.
* Work ethic based on a strong desire to exceed expectations.
* Ability to work successfully in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment. Requires excellent time management skills, ability to appropriately prioritize multiple, competing demands.
* Ability to translate technical control gaps into risk statement language.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related discipline.

**Preferred Experience**

* Relevant certifications or ability to obtain information security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, CISM or CRISC.

What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.
  
  
**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**

* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day-to-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

description:

**A Day in the Life**
The Identity Lifecycle and Governance team is responsible for how users within an organization are given an identity, and how it is protected, which includes securing critical applications, data, and systems from unauthorized access while managing the identities and access rights of people the organization. The Principal Identity Governance Specialist is the senior technical resource with a primary focus on access certifications, entitlement governance, and audit readiness. * Translate governance policies, regulatory requirements, and control objectives into scalable certification.
* Define integration requirements:

+ Out-of-the-box and custom connectors
+ API-based, file-based, database-based, and directory-based integrations
+ Specify required attributes, aggregation rules, mappings, and correlation logic to support accurate certifications.

* Architect and configure:

+ User, entitlement, role, and application certifications
+ Reviewer assignment logic and delegation models
+ Escalation paths, reminders, and completion SLAs
+ Automated remediation and revocation workflows

* Review and approve changes impacting:

+ Certification accuracy
+ Control effectiveness
+ Auditability or scalability

+ Provide detailed technical explanations of certification logic, configurations, and automation to internal and external auditors.
+ Collaborate with business and application teams to ensure governance requirements align with source system capabilities.
+ Maintain configuration documentation, certification runbooks, and operational reporting.
+ Continuously evaluate features and industry best practices to enhance certification effectiveness.
+ Recommend governance and security enhancements to leadership based on risk, audit findings, and platform capabilities.

**Required Knowledge and Expertise:**

* Bachelor’s degree / University degree
* 12+ years of IT experience with a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, MCA, or MSc. with experience in Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) or IAM.
* Hands-on experience operating SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, with deep focus on access certifications and reviews.
* Strong expertise in:

+ User, entitlement, and role certifications
+ Identity correlation and aggregation
+ Entitlement modeling and RBAC

* Familiarity with scripting or automation used alongside SailPoint (e.g., REST APIs, PowerShell).
* Experience with SailPoint integrations using connector-based, API-based, file-based, and database-backed approaches.

description:
Experience: 5 - 19 years
  
  
Max Experience: 19
  
  
WebApps Middleware - Web & Application Server Administrator
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
NTT DATA is seeking --years of Web & Middleware Administrator is responsible for installing, configuring, securing, optimizing, and supporting enterprise grade web servers, application servers, and middleware platforms across on premise and cloud environments. This role ensures highly available, scalable, and secure hosting for business applications while collaborating closely with development, security, DevOps, cloud, and infrastructure teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Web Server Administration (Apache HTTP, IBM IHS, NGINX, IIS)

Install, configure, and maintain Apache HTTP, IBM IHS, NGINX, and IIS across Linux/Windows environments.
  
  
Configure virtual hosts, reverse proxies, load balancing, SSL/TLS, mod\_security, mod\_jk/mod\_proxy, WAF rules, and request routing.
  
  
Manage certificates, keystores, aliasing, and automated certificate renewals.
  
  
Implement hardening guidelines (headers, ciphers, rate limits, firewall rules).
  
  
Monitor web traffic patterns, tune performance, and troubleshoot HTTP/HTTPS/SSL issues.
  
  

* Java Application Server Administration (WebLogic, WebSphere, JBoss, Tomcat, Oracle AS)

Install, configure, patch, and upgrade Oracle WebLogic, IBM WebSphere, JBoss EAP/WildFly, Apache Tomcat, and Oracle Application Server.
  
  
Manage JVM tuning, heap sizing, thread pools, JDBC data sources, JMS resources, session replication, and clusters.
  
  
Deploy EAR/WAR/JAR applications manually and via CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Troubleshoot application issues: classloader conflicts, memory leaks, thread dumps, GC tuning, connection pool bottlenecks.
  
  
Configure multi node clustering, domain creation, admin nodes, managed servers, and load balancers.
  
  
Set up security realms, LDAP/AD integration, JAAS, J2EE/Jakarta EE security policies.
  
  

* Performance Engineering & Monitoring

Configure and optimize caching, compression, keep alive, connection handling, request limits, and tuning parameters.
  
  
Monitor JVM performance, GC logs, thread/heap usage, and server KPIs.
  
  
Use monitoring tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk/ELK).
  
  

* Automation, DevOps & CI/CD Support

Automate server builds, deployments, and configurations using Shell, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, or Jenkins pipelines.
  
  
Integrate web/app servers with CI/CD (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
  
  
Maintain configuration-as-code for repeatable and compliant deployments.
  
  

* Security, Compliance & Hardening

Implement SSL/TLS, certificate rotation, PKI, keystore/truststore management.
  
  
Apply CIS, OWASP, STIG, and organization hardening benchmarks.
  
  
Manage access controls, RBAC, authentication modules, and secure admin interfaces.
  
  
Patch vulnerabilities, perform upgrades, and support security audits.
  
  

* High Availability, DR & Scalability

Set up clustering & load balancing for WebLogic, WebSphere, JBoss, Tomcat, and NGINX/IHS/IIS.
  
  
Manage horizontal/vertical scaling strategies.
  
  
Build and maintain DR environments, backups, replication, and failover testing.
  
  

* Troubleshooting & Operational Support

Diagnose issues across layers: OS, network, DNS, load balancing, reverse proxy, JVM, application code, backend integration.
  
  
Manage incident response, RCA, and preventive actions.
  
  
Provide 24×7 on call support (if required).

V – Sr. Engineer: Application Security Position: Senior Security Engineer – AppSec Department: 9909153 - IT Mountain Applications
  
  
Job Summary: The Senior Application Security Engineer acts as the bridge between Information Security and our Software Development teams. This role is responsible for securing the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) by integrating security tooling directly into CI/CD pipelines and performing technical security assessments on proprietary applications.
  
  
Crucially, this role is a cultural leader. You will build and nurture a "Security Champions" program, empowering developers to take ownership of security within their own products. You are not just finding bugs; you are teaching teams how to build secure code by design, fostering a partnership based on trust and mutual goals.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* Developer-Centric: You think like a developer because you have been one. You understand the pressure of sprint deadlines and strive to make security "frictionless."
* Relationship Builder: You know that the best way to secure software is to have the developers on your side. You approach vulnerability discussions with empathy and a "how do we fix this together" attitude.
* Curious & Technical: You love digging into code logic to find the flaw that automated scanners missed.
* Teacher & Mentor: You enjoy explaining why a Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability is dangerous and demonstrating how to write the code to prevent it.
* Pragmatic: You can distinguish between a theoretical risk and a practical exploit, helping business leaders make informed shipping decisions.

**Responsibilities Include**

* Security Champions Program: Help to launch, and manage a formal Security Champions program. Identify key advocates within development teams, provide them with advanced training, and build a community of practice.
* Secure SDLC (DevSecOps): Engineer and maintain the integration of security testing tools (SAST, DAST, SCA) into the CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab) to provide rapid feedback to developers.
* Application Security Testing: Conduct manual and automated penetration tests and code reviews on web applications, APIs, and mobile apps prior to release.
* Threat Modeling: Partner with engineering teams during the architecture/design phase to perform threat modeling (STRIDE/PASTA), identifying design flaws before code is even written.
* Vulnerability Management (AppSec): Triaging results from application scans, removing false positives, and creating clear, actionable Jira tickets for engineering teams.
* Developer Training: Create and deliver secure coding training (e.g., OWASP Top 10) tailored to the specific technology stacks used by the organization.
* Tool Engineering: Evaluate application security technologies and their reports (e.g., Stackhawk, or Qualys WAS).
* Policy & Standards: Assist in developing application security standards and coding guidelines that align with industry frameworks (ASVS, NIST). Experience you’ll need:
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information security, or equivalent experience.
* Development Background: Significant experience in software development or scripting (e.g., Java, .NET/C#, Python, JavaScript/Node.js). You must be able to read and understand the code you are securing.
* AppSec Expertise: Deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10, SANS 25, and common attack vectors (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, IDOR) and their remediations.
* Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on experience integrating security tools into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Tool Proficiency: Experience with SAST (Static Analysis), DAST (Dynamic Analysis), and SCA (Software Composition Analysis) tools.
* Cultural Leadership: Demonstrated experience building relationships with development teams or leading "Security Champions" initiatives.
* API Security: Strong understanding of API security, JSON Web Tokens (JWT), and API gateways.
* Communication: Ability to explain complex security exploits to non-security audiences and influence stakeholders to prioritize technical debt.
* Cloud Native Security: Familiarity with securing cloud-native applications (containers, Kubernetes, Serverless) in AWS or Azure. Preferred Experience:
* Certifications: CASE (Certified Application Security Engineer), CSSLP, GWEB, or OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional).
* Experience with Qualys Web App Scanning (WAS) module.
* Experience with "Infrastructure as Code" (IaC) security scanning (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
* Contribution to open-source security projects or bug bounty programs.

title: Staff Product Security Engineer, PSIRT
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
ServiceNow seeks a staff-level product security engineer to serve as a senior technical authority within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT). PSIRT is ServiceNow's awareness, response, and investigation capability for post-release vulnerabilities in ServiceNow-developed products and service offerings.
  
  
This role is for a recognized expert who can operate independently and as part of a team on the most significant security issues facing the platform—vulnerabilities that require evaluating intangibles. You will lead deep-dive investigations, coordinate resolution across engineering, product, and release teams, and demonstrate calm, decisive leadership during significant security events.
  
  
This is a role for someone who already understands product development cycles and the engineering and product relationships that drive them—and will use that fluency to lead fixes to completion under incident pressure. You will help shape how ServiceNow responds to product security vulnerabilities at scale and the technical rigor of the entire response capability.
  
  
**The Coverage Provided By This Role Is**

* Sunday: 02:00 - 10:00 UTC / 07:30 to 15:30 IST.
* Monday: 02:00 - 10:00 UTC / 07:30 to 15:30 IST.
* Tuesday: 02:00 - 10:00 UTC / 07:30 to 15:30 IST.
* Friday: 06:00 - 13:00 UTC / 11:30 - 18:30 IST.
* Saturday: 03:00 - 12:00 UTC / 08:30 - 17:30 IST.

Due to the nature of incident response and needs of the business, coverage may change. Additional coverage outside of stated hours may be required in response to significant incidents.
  
  
**What You Get To Do In This Role**
Lead Through Significant Security Events
  
  

* Demonstrate technical and organizational leadership during these events—bringing structure and clear decision-making under pressure.
* Partner with incident commanders, business information security leadership, engineering, and customer-facing teams to maintain clear ownership, workstream prioritization, and hand-offs during these events.

**Reduce Exposure Window**

* Drive coordinated response across affected releases, balancing risk and remediation feasibility.
* Leverage an understanding of product development cycles and engineering/product partnerships to move fixes through the release pipeline without stalling on organizational boundaries.
* Verify fix completeness and guard against incomplete mitigations before release.

**CVE & Coordinated Disclosure Process**

* Contributed to ServiceNow's CVE disclosure process for incidents you own—CVE assignment, scoring, advisory content, and publication timing.
* Conduct technical accuracy reviews of external advisories, researcher write-ups, and joint disclosure content to ensure correctness before publication.

**Pursue After-Action Outcomes & Continuous Improvement**

* Author root cause analyses and drive lessons learned to closure following product security incidents.
* Participate in retrospectives following significant product security events, translating findings into concrete process and technical improvements.
* Contribute to partner teams tracking product security risk themes and trends across the portfolio. Contribute to SDLC improvement areas, feeding incident learnings upstream into secure development practices.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Minimum 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years of experience; or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 4 years of auditing source code for security vulnerabilities.
* Demonstrated leadership during significant security events or major incidents, with willingness to participate in on-call.
* Ability to read and comprehend Java and JavaScript code.
* Strong understanding of common Java and JavaScript vulnerabilities.
* Proficiency in scripting in both Python and JavaScript for data gathering, processing, and visualization.
* Development of proof-of-concept exploits for web application vulnerabilities.
* Written and verbal communication of complex security risk clearly to both technical teams and leadership.
* Experience with leading fix implementation and release coordination across engineering, product, and test/release teams.
* Proficiency in deep-dive product security investigations and root-cause analysis spanning design, code, configuration, and operational layers.
* Exploit analysis and proof-of-concept development that distinguishes real exploitability from theoretical risk.
* Familiarity with SDLC integration, CI/CD pipelines, SaaS threat models, and secure development practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a PSIRT or similar function for a major software or SaaS platform.
* Recognized expertise in product security incident response, vulnerability research, or application security within a software or SaaS environment.
* Experience conducting vulnerability assessments on the ServiceNow platform.
* Experience with emerging threats: AI-specific attack vectors, software supply chain security, and SDLC tooling security.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized environments.
* Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSWE) or demonstrated equivalent expertise.

JV20
  
  
Additional Information

Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. title: Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management (IAM Engineer)
description:
**Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management**
The Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer is responsible for supporting, administering, engineering, and continuously improving enterprise identity and access management services. This role works as part of the Digital Identity & Access team to deliver secure, reliable, and efficient identity services across the organization. The IAM Engineer will support identity lifecycle management, authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access, application integrations, certificates, and related identity technologies. The successful candidate will combine strong technical capabilities with disciplined operational practices, documentation, change management, and collaboration across Technology and Information Security teams. This is a hybrid role and work hours are 2pm – 11pm IST.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Identity & Access Management**

* Support the administration and engineering of enterprise identity and access management platforms and services.
* Configure and maintain Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), authentication policies, and Conditional Access controls.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory identity services.
* Support identity lifecycle processes including user provisioning, modification, deprovisioning, and access changes.
* Troubleshoot complex authentication, authorization, and access-related issues.
* Support application onboarding and integration with enterprise identity platforms using technologies and standards such as SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and related authentication protocols.
* Support identity federation and authentication integrations with SaaS, cloud, and internally developed applications.
* Assist with the administration and support of Auth0 and other enterprise authentication platforms.
* Support role-based access control and group-based access management.

**Identity Security & Governance**

* Partner with Information Security to implement and maintain identity security standards and controls.
* Support periodic access reviews, certifications, audit requests, and compliance activities.
* Assist with the implementation and maintenance of appropriate separation-of-duties controls.
* Identify excessive, inappropriate, or outdated access and work with appropriate stakeholders to remediate identified issues.
* Support privileged identity and access management processes where applicable.
* Assist with investigation and remediation of identity-related security events.
* Ensure identity configurations and processes align with organizational security standards and established governance requirements.

**PKI & Certificate Management**

* Support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and certificate-management processes.
* Monitor certificate expiration and coordinate certificate renewals to prevent service disruption.
* Assist application and technology teams with certificate requests, renewals, deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain accurate documentation and visibility into enterprise certificates and associated ownership.

**Engineering & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IAM activities and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain scripts and automation supporting identity administration, reporting, provisioning, and operational processes.
* Support integrations between IAM platforms, enterprise applications, HR systems, and other technology services.
* Participate in identity-platform upgrades, enhancements, migrations, and modernization initiatives.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of IAM architecture, standards, technical documentation, and operational procedures.

**Service Management & Operations**

* Manage IAM incidents, requests, problems, and changes in accordance with established service-management processes.
* Develop implementation, testing, validation, rollback, and communication plans for production changes.
* Ensure changes are appropriately documented, reviewed, approved, and communicated prior to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely visibility into assigned work, projects, changes, risks, and commitments.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, and support runbooks.
* Participate in troubleshooting and resolution of major incidents involving identity or authentication services.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions.

**Collaboration & Customer Experience**

* Partner with Digital Workplace, Information Security, Infrastructure, Application Development, Enterprise Systems, HR, Service Management, and other technology teams.
* Provide technical guidance to application owners integrating applications with enterprise identity services.
* Communicate technical issues, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Balance security requirements with the need to provide reliable and intuitive authentication and access experiences for practitioners.
* Demonstrate a collaborative, accountable, and service-oriented approach to delivering identity services.

**Essential Traits**

* 3–5+ years of experience supporting or engineering enterprise Identity & Access Management technologies.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory.
* Experience implementing or supporting Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Conditional Access.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications using SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, or similar authentication standards.
* Experience troubleshooting complex authentication and access-related issues.
* Understanding of identity lifecycle management, including provisioning, deprovisioning, access changes, and role/group management.
* Working knowledge of identity security principles, least privilege, role-based access control, and separation of duties.
* Experience working within formal change, incident, request, and problem-management processes.
* Strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across technical teams and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

**About Kroll**
In a world of disruption and increasingly complex business challenges, our professionals bring truth into focus with the Kroll Lens. Our sharp analytical skills, paired with the latest technology, allow us to give our clients clarity—not just answering all areas of business. We value the diverse backgrounds and perspectives that enable us to think globally. As part of One team, One Kroll, you will contribute to a supportive and collaborative work environment that empowers you to excel.
  
  
Kroll is the premier global valuation and corporate finance advisor with expertise in complex valuation, disputes and investigations, M&A, restructuring, and compliance and regulatory consulting. Our professionals balance analytical skills, deep market insight and independence to help our clients make sound decisions. As an organization, we think globally—and encourage our people to do the same.
  
  
*Kroll is committed to equal opportunity and diversity, and recruits people based on merit.*

*careers.kroll.com*

,

title: Senior SAP Basis and Security Administration Engineer
description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Corporation
  
  
**Company Details:**
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SAP Basis Administration Engineer to support the administration, security execution, and integration maintenance for our SAP ECC 6.0 on HANA landscape under the direction of the SAP Basis & Security Manager. Our SAP infrastructure is hosted and managed by a third-party hosting/managed-services hosting partner, so this role is heavily focused on technical oversight, working with hosting partner governance, and ensuring the hosting partner executes Basis operations to our standards. This is an equally weighted Basis and Security role: the ideal candidate has deep SAP ECC/HANA Basis expertise and hands-on ownership of SAP security administration, plus proven experience configuring integrations using PI/PO, SFTP, cloud-based integration agents and supporting enterprise archiving workflow.
  
  
**Job Details:**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
SAP Basis Administration (Hosting Partner Environment)
  
  

* Execute and coordinate day-to-day technical operational interactions with the third-party hosting partner for all SAP ECC 6.0 on HANA Basis activities — driving accountability.
* Support patch, kernel upgrade, and support pack revision update, and system enhancement initiatives following established governance and architecture.
* Work with SAP functional and technical teams to support systems refreshes, client copies, transport management, and landscape maintenance.
* Relentlessly monitor SAP ECC/HANA system performance, verify hosting partner SLAs (performance, availability, response times), and escalate issues to internal leadership when standards slip.
* Perform systems performance analysis and capacity trending. Analyze usage patterns, system headroom, and assist in executing database archiving strategies and capacity plans per lead direction.
* Support disaster recovery planning, testing (backup/restore, HANA system replication/HSR, failover), and validation activities to ensure business continuity readiness.
* Maintain rigorous operational documentation, execution logs, and internal oversight records.

SAP Security Administration
  
  

* Maintain and support the SAP authorization concept — roles, composite roles, profiles, and organizational-level restrictions — across the ECC 6.0/HANA landscape in accordance with established security policies.
* Execute user access lifecycle management, including provisioning, de-provisioning, access recertification, and enforcement of least-privilege principles across all clients and environments (Dev/QA/Prod).
* Drive Perform segregation of duties (SoD) analysis and remediation, proactively identifying and resolving conflicting access before it becomes an audit finding, and maintaining a clean SoD ruleset aligned to business risk.
* Support Internal Audit, InfoSec, and external auditors on all SAP security assessments.
* Proactively monitor for anomalous access patterns, dormant accounts, and emerging authorization risk, bringing forward remediation plans before issues are flagged externally.
* Define, document, and enforce SAP security standards, naming conventions, and role-build methodology, ensuring consistency and auditability across the entire authorization landscape.

Integration Configuration
  
  

* Configure and support of interfaces built on SAP PI/PO (IDoc, RFC, SOAP, REST, File adapters), driving configuration, proactive monitoring, and rapid troubleshooting across every SAP-to-third-party connection.
* Support and maintain SFTP-based data exchange processes, including connection monitoring, key/credential management, SSL/TLS certificate updates, and coordinating network/firewall changes with the hosting partner.
* Practical experience on SAP SAML configuration.
* Configure, maintain, and support cloud-based integration agents/connectors (e.g., SAP Cloud Connector or equivalent middleware agents), ensuring a secure, reliable bridge between the hosting partner's ECC environment and cloud/third-party applications.
* Guarantee that integration channels remain secure, thoroughly documented, and resilient against disruption from hosting partner-side changes (e.g., patching, network reconfiguration) — anticipating issues before they impact the business.
* Support enterprise background processing and automated workflows (e.g., SAP Redwood job schedulers).

**Required Qualifications**
Basis and Security
  
  

* 5-7 years of hands-on SAP Basis and security administration experience, including at least 2–3 years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong, specific experience with SAP ECC 6.0 on HANA — architecture, transport management, and system landscape design.
* Working knowledge of HANA database administration concepts and SLT.
* Proven ownership of SAP authorization concepts across a large, complex landscape, including experience leading audit responses and access recertification cycles.
* Experience working with SLA management and change governance.
* Experience in executing archiving large tables and overall systems performance tuning.
* Practical experience setting up and maintaining SFTP connections for secure file-based integrations.
* Experience configuring and managing cloud-based integration agents (e.g., SAP Cloud Connector or similar).
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills, with the ability to assess hosting-partner-delivered work critically.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of SAP best-practice data archiving strategies (e.g., SARA/archive object configuration, retention policies, and database growth management) to support long-term system performance and storage optimization.
* Experience with enterprise job scheduling systems (e.g., SAP Redwood CPS/BPA).
* Exposure to OpenText solutions (Vendor Invoice Management / VIM, Content Server, or Archive Center).
* Experience with tax system interface maintenance (e.g., Vertex updates/patching).
* Familiarity supporting connections to enterprise cloud integration and analytics tools (e.g., Workato, Palantir connectors, Tableau, Alteryx, BOBJ).
* SAP certification(s) in Basis, Security, or Integration technologies.
* Experience with SAP GRC Access Control (Access Risk Analysis, Emergency Access Management, Access Request Management) and automated access review tools.
* Experience and knowledge in PI/PO a plus,

title: Shift Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Transportation Systems
  
  
**Company Details:**
When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  
  
We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
  
  
**Job Details:**
**Job Summary**
As a Shift Coordinator on the CTS 24x7 Service Operations team, you will provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 staff across the Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), and Service Desk during your assigned shift. You act as the technical and operational command authority during the shift. You are responsible for ensuring that events across all three functions are correctly triaged, tickets are properly assigned and tracked, incidents are escalated per defined protocols, and shift handovers preserve full situational awareness for the incoming shift.
  
  
You are responsible for confirming shift staffing coverage in real time and for adjusting assignments to accommodate last-minute absences. You are the immediate escalation path for issues that exceed the authority of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts on the shift, and you escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for issues that exceed shift authority.
  
  
Work is conducted under the compliance frameworks that govern CTS operations, in particular ITIL 4 (Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management, Continual Improvement), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Annex A logging, monitoring, and incident management controls), and PCI DSS v4.0.1 (Requirements 10 and 12.10). You will be recognized inside CTS as the shift-level owner for cross-function coordination and evidence continuity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**
**Shift Command and Team Coordination**

* Provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC, SOC, and Service Desk analysts during the assigned shift.
* Assign work at shift start and re-balance workload throughout the shift based on ticket volume, incident severity, and individual analyst capacity.
* Confirm complete shift coverage across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues at shift start; adjust in real time when staff are unavailable because of sick calls, unplanned PTO, or emergency absence.
* Serve as the initial escalation point for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 analyst who needs additional authority, judgment, or cross-functional coordination.
* Track and report shift-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, incident count by severity) at shift close.

**Shift Handover Discipline**

* Execute a formal shift handover at the start and end of every shift, per the protocols defined in the NOC Scope Definition and the CTS SOC Scope of Operations.
* Ensure the handover record captures, at minimum: open incidents with owner and next action; active containment actions in progress; watchlist items; active maintenance windows; tooling or coverage gaps.
* Retain handover records as ISMS evidence supporting ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5.10 and ITIL 4 Monitoring and Event Management practice.

**Incident Management Coordination**

* Apply ITIL 4 Incident Management practice throughout the shift: validate alerts, classify severity, assign ownership, coordinate escalation, and track resolution against SLA.
* Coordinate the first 15 to 30 minutes of any SEV 0 or SEV 1 incident: declare the incident, engage the appropriate tiers, initiate stakeholder communications, and hand off to the Incident Commander or on-call Tier 3 engineer.
* Enforce severity special rules from the NOC Scope Definition (for example, loss of logging or monitoring is never a SEV 4 event; SEV 0 or SEV 1 with a recent production change requires a change correlation step).
* Ensure joint NOC-SOC coordination during Major Incidents: NOC leads operational recovery; SOC leads security investigation and containment; the Shift Coordinator maintains the shared incident bridge until the Incident Commander takes over.

**Cross-Function Ticket Routing and Escalation**

* Monitor NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues in the ITSM platform; ensure tickets are correctly categorized and assigned per the RACI.
* Route security-relevant events from the NOC or Service Desk to the SOC per the defined Escalation pathway with enriched context.
* Route operational recovery actions from the SOC to the NOC or regional IT Operations per the defined protocol.
* Escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for any issue that exceeds shift authority.

**Compliance Evidence and Documentation**

* Ensure shift activities produce audit-ready evidence supporting PCI DSS v4.0.1 Requirement 10 and Requirement 12.10, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5.24-A.5.28 and A.8.15-A.8.16.
* Verify handover records, incident timelines, and containment action logs are complete and accurate before shift close.
* Support monthly and quarterly evidence pack preparation.

**Continuous Improvement Contribution**

* Identify recurring patterns during the shift (repeat incidents, noisy alerts, gaps in playbook coverage) and log them for review by the NOC, SOC, and Service Desk Managers.
* Participate in post-incident reviews and contribute to the Continual Improvement Register per ITIL 4 Continual Improvement practice.
* Recommend changes to shift-level procedures where the shift experience identifies opportunities.

**General Duties And Responsibilities**

* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to work effectively and uphold professional standards, with the customer and system stakeholders.
* Self-motivated and able to work unsupervised.
* Methodical and attentive to detail.
* Proactive in seeking advice from senior operations and security subject matter experts when required.
* Comfortable working with staff at all levels and in other geographical locations within the organization.
* Comply with Cubic's Quality Management System.
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures.

**Skills / Experience / Knowledge**
**Essential:**

* Experience providing direct supervision to a team of individual contributors in a technology operations, security operations, or service desk environment.
* Working knowledge of NOC operations: event monitoring, incident management, SLA management, change and configuration control.
* Working knowledge of SOC operations: SIEM and EDR alert triage, security incident classification, escalation protocols.
* Working knowledge of Service Desk operations under a Tier 1-3 tiered model.
* Familiarity with ITIL 4 practices, in particular Monitoring and Event Management and Incident Management.
* Ability to interpret and explain incident status, containment actions, and escalation decisions to peers, subordinate staff, and functional peer groups. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Collaboration and Interaction expectations.
* Sound judgment in resolving problems that require analysis of data and relevant factors under real-time pressure. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Complexity and Problem Solving expectations.
* Ability to develop and manage routine operational plans and meet targets against a monthly performance plan. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Discretion and Impact expectations.
* Experience preparing accurate shift reports and handover records.
* Comfort operating 24x7 shift patterns, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.

**Desirable:**

* Familiarity with PCI DSS v4.0.1 requirements, in particular Requirement 10, Requirement 11.5, and Requirement 12.10.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls covering logging (A.8.15), monitoring activities (A.8.16), and incident management (A.5.24 to A.5.28).
* Exposure to NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 (NIST CSWP 29) Detect and Respond Functions.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent enterprise ITSM) and Jira.
* Understanding of the ITIL 4 Major Incident model and Problem Management practice.
* Experience coordinating across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk boundaries.

**Qualifications**
**Essential:**

* Must be able to work on-site at Cubic Hyderabad, Aparna Plaza, on a 24x7 rotating shift pattern.
* Minimum 5-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree.
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other technical field; or Business Administration with relevant IT work experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in a Tier 1-3 operations environment (NOC, SOC, Service Desk, or NOC/SOC hybrid).
* At least 3 years’ experience managing shift workers.
* Demonstrated ability to make severity classification and escalation decisions in a real-time operations setting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a team through a shift, including workload assignment, coaching, and formal handover.
* At least 3 years’ experience working in an ITIL 4 operation.

**Desirable:**

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader preferred.
* CompTIA Security+, ISC2 SSCP, or equivalent security operations certification.
* ServiceNow ITSM administrator or user certification.
* Experience in a payment card processing environment, or in a similarly regulated real-time operations environment.
* Experience with global follow-the-sun shift models spanning NAM, EMEA, and APAC time zones.

Successful outcome of a National Police Check

title: Windows Infrastructure & Microsoft 365 Support Engineer - L1+
description:
**Job Summary**
**Job Description**
**We are seeking an L1+ Windows Infrastructure and Microsoft 365 Support Engineer to join our 24/7 IT operations team. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring, administration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of Windows Server infrastructure, Active Directory, Hyper-V, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, and Microsoft 365 services. The role requires the ability to independently resolve routine and moderately complex incidents, execute approved changes, meet service-level agreements (SLAs), and escalate complex issues with appropriate technical evidence.**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server infrastructure, including operating systems, services, scheduled tasks, event logs, performance issues, RDP connectivity, file servers, permissions, and hardware health.
* Monitor server availability, CPU, memory, disk utilization, disk I/O, network connectivity, and infrastructure health; maintain server inventory and perform routine health checks.
* Manage Active Directory users, groups, computers, OUs, password resets, account unlocks, and privileged access; troubleshoot GPOs, AD replication, domain controller health, SYSVOL, authentication, and account lockouts.
* Administer DNS and DHCP services, troubleshoot name resolution and IP allocation issues, and support FSMO role awareness, Windows Time Service, and domain time synchronization.
* Monitor and administer Hyper-V hosts, virtual machines, virtual disks, checkpoints, and Windows Failover Clusters; troubleshoot VM availability and identify orphaned VHD/VHDX files.
* Perform approved Windows Server patching, including pre-checks, backup verification, deployment, reboot coordination, post-patch validation, and compliance reporting; monitor backup jobs and support restore validation, vulnerability remediation, CIS compliance, and security hardening.
* Monitor infrastructure using ManageEngine OpManager, PRTG, Zabbix, or equivalent tools; investigate alerts, troubleshoot recurring issues, and coordinate remediation.
* Administer Microsoft Entra ID users, groups, licenses, and access; troubleshoot authentication, MFA, Conditional Access, sign-in issues, and Entra Connect synchronization failures.
* Perform basic Azure administration, including VM health, availability, monitoring, networking, and access checks; support certificate expiry monitoring and PKI-related troubleshooting.
* Administer Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online, including users, licenses, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, mailbox permissions, and resource mailboxes; troubleshoot mail flow, NDRs, message delivery, Outlook connectivity, and hybrid mail routing where applicable.
* Support Microsoft Intune device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, and endpoint management; troubleshoot SharePoint Online permissions, OneDrive synchronization, and Microsoft Teams access and meeting issues.
* Investigate phishing reports, quarantined emails, and Microsoft Defender for Office 365 alerts; support security investigations, audit evidence collection, and compliance reporting.
* Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, and Exchange Online PowerShell for routine administration, troubleshooting, reporting, and approved automation activities.
* Manage incidents and service requests through ConnectWise, ServiceDesk Plus, or equivalent ticketing tools; meet SLAs, execute approved changes, follow rollback and maker-checker procedures, and escalate complex issues with appropriate technical evidence.
* Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, daily health checks, shift handovers, and periodic reports while coordinating with internal teams, customers, and vendors in a 24/7 rotational support environment.

**Requirements**
**Job Requirements**
**Required Technical Skills**

* Hands-on Windows Server administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Working knowledge of AD, GPO, DNS, DHCP, replication, and authentication.
* Practical knowledge of Hyper-V, virtual disks, and Windows Failover Clustering fundamentals.
* Experience with patching, monitoring, backup operations, and vulnerability remediation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure fundamentals, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Intune, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Office 365, certificates/PKI, and PowerShell.
* Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS resolution, RDP, ports, and network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience with ticketing systems, incident management, change management, and SLA-driven support.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Experience: 3–4 years in Windows Infrastructure, NOC, Systems Administration, or Microsoft 365 support.
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred.
* Microsoft certifications such as AZ-900, AZ-104, MS-900, or relevant role-based certifications are desirable.
* Willingness to work in 24/7 rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays according to the roster.
