title: Microsoft 365 Engineer
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
**About This Role**
The Microsoft 365 Engineer is the hands-on technical owner for the day-to-day administration, configuration, and optimization of the KGS Microsoft 365 tenant, covering Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Viva Engage, Microsoft Loop, Planner, Forms, Stream, Bookings, and Microsoft 365 Apps. This individual contributor role reports to the Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery & Digital Workplace and supports employees across the global KGS tenant from India.
  
  
The role is equally accountable for adoption across the organization, making sure employees at every site and in every function know how to use Microsoft 365 well. Success is measured through usage data, training reach, and reduced support demand. The engineer works within the standards set by the governance and cyber security teams, turning policy into services that are well run and well used.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Microsoft 365 Platform Administration**

* Administer and configure Exchange Online, including mail flow, connectors, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and transport rules.
* Administer SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business, including site provisioning, permissions, storage, and sharing settings.
* Administer Microsoft Teams, including meeting, calling, and messaging policies, app management, and Teams Rooms where applicable.
* Configure and support Viva Engage, Microsoft Loop, Planner, Forms, Stream, and Bookings, and manage tenant settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
* Manage Microsoft 365 Apps deployment and update channels in partnership with the endpoint team.
* Automate administration tasks using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph, and maintain configuration documentation and as-built standards.

**Identity, Licensing & Access**

* Manage license assignment through group-based licensing, along with Microsoft 365 groups and membership, within approved access policies.
* Partner with the identity team on Entra ID, conditional access, and MFA as they affect Microsoft 365 services, escalating exceptions to the policy owner.
* Track license consumption and report right-sizing opportunities to the Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery & Digital Workplace.

**Governance, Security & Compliance (Execution)**

* Apply the Teams and SharePoint standards set by the governance and cyber security teams to provisioning, naming, lifecycle and expiration, external sharing, and guest access.
* Implement Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, retention policies, and data loss prevention (DLP) policies as directed by the cyber security and compliance teams.
* Action eDiscovery and legal hold requests as directed by the legal team.
* Review Microsoft Secure Score and recommendations relevant to Microsoft 365 workloads, and remediate findings with approval.

**Adoption & Change Management (Organization-wide)**

* Build and execute the Microsoft 365 adoption plan across all KGS sites and functions, and establish and run a Microsoft 365 Champions program.
* Create training content, including quick-reference guides, short videos, live and virtual sessions, and onboarding content for new hires.
* Run targeted campaigns that move teams from file shares and email attachments to collaboration in OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams, and that introduce tools such as Loop and Planner.
* Use Microsoft 365 usage analytics, Adoption Score, and Viva Insights where available to measure adoption, identify low-usage groups, and target them.
* Maintain an internal Microsoft 365 help and learning hub on SharePoint.
* Communicate Message Center roadmap changes to the business in plain language ahead of rollout.

**Migration & Projects**

* Execute file share and legacy platform migrations into SharePoint Online and OneDrive using the SharePoint Migration Tool, Migration Manager, or third-party tools.
* Support tenant consolidation, merger and acquisition, and divestiture work as required.
* Pilot and roll out new Microsoft 365 features in a controlled, well-communicated way.

**Support, Monitoring & Service Management**

* Serve as the second and third-level escalation point for Microsoft 365 incidents raised by the service desk and IT Field Engineers.
* Monitor Service Health and Message Center, assess the impact of incidents and changes, and manage Microsoft support cases through to resolution.
* Use ITIL Incident, Problem, and Change Management practices in the ITSM tool.
* Create knowledge base articles that enable the service desk to resolve Microsoft 365 issues at first contact.
* Will be the on-call for critical Microsoft 365 incidents.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 4–5 years' experience administering Microsoft 365 in an enterprise environment.
* Hands-on administration experience with Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams.
* PowerShell scripting for Microsoft 365 administration, with working knowledge of Entra ID and license management.
* Experience delivering end-user training or adoption activities.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices and hands-on experience with an ITSM tool.
* Able to work onsite at the assigned KGS site in India, with the ability to travel up to 10%.
* Flexible schedule to accommodate overlap with the Americas and Europe and occasional on-call needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, or Collaboration Communications Systems Engineer.
* Experience delivering SharePoint Online migrations at enterprise scale.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview, including sensitivity labels, retention, data loss prevention, and eDiscovery.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph API, Power Automate, and the wider Power Platform.
* Prosci or other change management certification, with experience running Microsoft 365 champion programs.
* Readiness and rollout experience with Copilot for Microsoft 365.
* Experience with Intune and Microsoft 365 Apps deployment.
* Experience in manufacturing or multi-site global organizations.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Strong communicator, able to explain technology clearly to non-technical users.
* Trainer and presenter mindset, comfortable leading sessions for audiences of any size.
* Strong customer service orientation, displaying professional standards.
* Analytical and data-driven, using usage data to guide adoption decisions.
* Keen attention to detail in configuration and change control.
* Automation-first mindset, scripting repeatable tasks rather than repeating them by hand.
* Manages conflicting priorities and stays calm under pressure during incidents.
* Able to work autonomously and follow direction as provided.
* Collaborates effectively with peers and stakeholders across time zones.
* Continuously learns and keeps pace as the Microsoft 365 roadmap evolves.
* Challenges the status quo and drives improvement.
* Strong organizational and task management skills in a fast-paced environment.

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

title: Senior Linux Platform / Appliance Engineer
description:
About the Role

Seeking a hands-on senior engineer to design, build, secure, release, upgrade, troubleshoot, and support the Linux platform used by the EMS enterprise appliance. EMS is deployed on physical or virtual systems in customer environments. The position requires deep Linux systems engineering combined with appliance lifecycle, containers, networking, security, virtualization, automation, and offline or air-gapped deployment experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and maintain the Linux platform for physical and virtual EMS appliances.
* Build repeatable, version-controlled, and potentially immutable Linux images.
* Own the appliance lifecycle from build and provisioning throughdeployment, validation, upgrade,rollback, recovery, diagnostics, and reimaging.
* Engineer installation and update solutions for on-premises, low-connectivity, offline, and air-gapped environments.
* Design safe OS and application update, rollback, health-validation, and recovery mechanisms.
* Engineer and troubleshoot Linux boot, systemd,networking, storage, filesystems, firewalling, logging, packages, permissions, and services.
* Deploy and manage containerized applications using Podman, Docker, Kubernetes/MicroK8s, or equivalent technologies.
* Use Podman, Quadlet, and systemd-managed containers where appropriate.
* Support physical hardware and virtual appliances across KVM, VMware, Hyper-V, or equivalent platforms.
* Implement Linux hardening, certificate management, vulnerability remediation, package integrity, and platform security controls.
* Automate appliance image creation, testing, packaging, validation, and release.
* Build fielddiagnostics and recoverycapabilities and collaborate with software engineering, QA, cybersecurity, product, infrastructure, and support teams.

Required Experience

* 7+ yearsin Linux platformengineering, Linux systemsengineering, enterprise appliance engineering, embedded or edge Linux, infrastructure engineering, or a similar role.
* Deep hands-on Linux experience, preferably Ubuntu, RHEL, Fedora, or another enterprise Linux distribution.
* Strong knowledge of systemd, Linuxboot and OS lifecycle, networking, firewalling, storage, filesystems, package management, logging, diagnostics, security, permissions, and Bash or Python scripting.
* Experience building image-based, immutable, embedded, edge, or appliance-style Linux platforms.
* Experience creating automated OS images using Packer, custom ISO or image pipelines, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience designing upgrade, rollback, recovery, and reimaging solutions.
* Experience supporting on-premises, field-deployed, low-connectivity, offline, or air-gapped systems.
* Strong container experience with Podman, Docker, containerd, or equivalent OCI technologies.
* Experience with self-managed or on-premises Kubernetes environments.

* Strong troubleshooting skills across Linux, networking, storage, containers, virtualization, and application services.
* Ability to independently design and deliver production-ready, secure, and supportable solutions.

Nice to Have

* Podman, Quadlet, and systemd-based container management.
* MicroK8s, K3s, or another lightweight Kubernetes distribution.
* Immutable Linux technologies such as Ubuntu Core, Fedora CoreOS, OSTree/rpm-ostree, read-only root filesystems, or A/B OS architectures.
* Virtual appliance experience with KVM, VMware, Hyper-V, OVA/OVF, QCOW2, VHD, or VHDX.
* Packer, Ansible, Git, infrastructure automation, and automated testing.
* CI/CD pipeline and build/release automation knowledge.
* Cloud engineering experience, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Infrastructure-as-code practicesand cloud servicessupporting artifact management, security scanning, testing,monitoring, or releases.
* Linux security hardening, CIS Benchmarks, PKI, certificates, trust stores, signed updates, and artifact validation.
* Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, journald, or equivalent observability technologies.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a Linux engineer who builds platforms and products, not simply someone who administers Linux servers. The strongest candidates will have experience with Linux-based appliances, industrial or edge systems, networking or security appliances, embedded platforms, or other long-lived on-premises products where reliability, security, controlled updates, offline operation, and field serviceability are critical.

title: Sr. Security Engineer
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY:**
The Sr Security Engineer is a technical security position in the F5 Security Incident Response Team (F5 SIRT). Addressing security issues in F5 products is the responsibility of the F5 Security Incident Response Team (F5 SIRT). The F5 SIRT is a dedicated, global team that manages the receipt, investigation, and public reporting of security vulnerability information that is related to F5 products and networks.
  
  
The Sr Security Engineer position provides expert security technical leadership for F5 SIRT. This position requires complete Security Knowledge and an expert with regards to security threats, incident handling methodologies and offensive/defensive attack vectors. A Sr Security Engineer follows incident handling procedures to drive mitigation of security incidents and will be called to perform expert attack analysis, configuration suggestions, and potential onsite interaction. A Sr Security Engineer can handle multiple active issues of diverse scope simultaneously while maintaining good communication, particularly written communication to our customers, and accepts ownership of issues until a resolution is delivered or a business as usual state is returned, providing high customer satisfaction. When not engaged in incidents, a Sr Security Engineer will mentor other security related issues, researches emerging threats and both documents and presents their impact on F5 products and services. Advocates every single day for improving the security of F5 products and services.
  
  
A good candidate has a deep passion for security and a desire to help develop a security mindset in others. The role also requires a strong ability to work with incomplete information and to adapt to changing priorities.
  
  
**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Responsible for upholding F5s business code of ethics & for promptly reporting violations of the code or other company policies
* Manages multiple issues and prioritizes based upon customer and business needs, without direction
* Provides F5 customers with a consistently high-quality support experience
* Assist other Security Engineers with other tasks as required based upon business operation needs
* Effectively engages supporting escalation personnel, without direction
* Participate in weekend support rotation
* Participate in tier 2 and tier 3 security support
* Provides F5 customers with high-quality support experience
* Manages multiple issues and prioritizes based upon customer and business needs, without direction
* Effectively engages supporting escalation personnel, without direction
* Ensure complete and clear incident documentation
* Maintain incident documentation, participate in post-mortems, and write incident reports.
* Continuous research into emerging threats and mitigation options
* Independently develops and deliver security content and training based on research and testing within the security field and with F5 products to drive security mindset.
* Perform general security awareness and specific security technology training
* Engages in ongoing training within the security field and with F5 products
* Follows processes defined in F5’s Quality Management System (QMS)
* Work closely with others to develop incident response plans
* Identify the gaps between the security incident response process and customers' needs, optimize/improve the workflow/process
* Act as the technical lead, identify the knowledge/technical skill gaps in the team, develop a training plan for the team, mentor/train other members of the team
* Identify trends and/or common knowledge gaps and ensure they are documented via the KCS Solve Loop
* Ensure that security-related knowledge is documented within KCS and represent Security within the KCS Evolve Loop, for example RCA feedback into product design & documentation
* May lead projects and provide guidance/training to less experienced staff, mentoring.
* Perform expert threat and vulnerability management, monitoring of CVE, and vendor notifications
* Evaluate and execute cross-functional security initiatives across the enterprise.
* Work with cross-functional Engineering teams to ensure all systems are properly remediated according to our policies and standards.
* Lead steering committee(s) to analyze vulnerabilities and their impact to assess risk ratings
* Provide strategic security analytics metrics and reports.
* Capable of anticipating future business challenges and crafting security strategies that mitigate those risks
* Provide security-related metrics for all levels, including executive-level dashboards to demonstrate process effectiveness and remediation across the enterprise
* Effectively communicate and document risks related to the vulnerability environment and appropriate levels of urgency to management and engineering staff
* Represent Security on organizational projects and ensure adherence to existing security policies and standards.
* Work closely with Incident Response and Risk Management teams and leverage corporate tools to provide supporting documentation for remediation prioritization and emergency security coverage.
* Ability to think with a security mindset. The successful candidate has a strong IT background with in-depth knowledge of several key security practice areas: application security, network security, and infrastructure security.

Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) and Vulnerability Management
  
  

* Monitor and identify security vulnerabilities in F5’s products and Services by tracking internal reports, external researcher submissions, bug bounty programs, and industry threat intelligence
* Triage and assess reported vulnerabilities and incidents, determining severity, impact, and prioritization based on risk to customers and systems
* Coordinate with Product Engineering, Product Management, Legal, Corporate Communications, and other teams to develop security advisories for security issues.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders, disseminating clear security advisories, mitigations, and fix notifications to customers, partners, and the public.
* Manage interactions with external security researchers, validating vulnerability disclosures, and facilitating recognition or rewards through bug bounty programs when applicable.
* Document all security incidents, responses, and resolutions to ensure compliance, support audits, and drive process improvements.
* Develop, maintain, and update security/Quarterly Security Notification (QSN) playbooks, and workflows to optimize vulnerability management and incident response processes.
* Engage with the broader security community, participating in industry forums, sharing threat intelligence, and collaborating with other PSIRTs to stay ahead of emerging threats (CISA, FIRST, VINCE, etc).

Customer Security Incident Response
  
  

* Provide incident handling and drive both attack analysis and mitigation options
* Participate in tier 2 and tier 3 security support
* Follows processes defined in F5’s Quality Management System (QMS)
* Mentoring Security SRs to resolution - Proactively monitors Security Service Request (SR) with long Time to Resolution (TTR)
* Working with F5 SIRT Specialists to handle ESRP cases
* Maintain incident documentation, participate in post-mortems, and write incident reports.
* Working with SR Security Engineers on post-mortem for ESRP incidents
* Tracking attack trends and threat intelligence from different sources
* Monitors security issues in order to identify and act upon them as they occur – Active Mentoring
* Running workshops to help F5 SIRT Specialists build hands-on experience in a lab environment in order to better prepare for dealing with attacks in the real environment – With Sr. Sec Eng
* Simulating a typical customer network environment (in terms of versions, modules, network devices), running different attacks, documenting the security incident response plan, and exercising it
* Work closely with others to develop incident response plans

Building Security Mindset - Security Evangelism
  
  

* Running regional F5 SIRT meetings
* Handling reactive mentor questions on Security from F5 SIRT Specialists and NSEs – Monitor F5 SIRT email
* Creating security presentations for a wide audience
* Engages in ongoing training within the security field and with F5 products
* May lead projects and provide guidance/training to less experienced staff and mentoring.
* Evaluate and execute cross-functional security initiatives across the enterprise.

Work with cross-functional Engineering teams to ensure all systems are properly remediated according to our policies and standards.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS:
  
  

* Minimum of 15 years of experience in a technical security role such as support, monitoring or consulting (e.g. pen testing) working with relevant technologies
* Information security subject matter expert
* Expert understanding of industry standards such as CVE, CPE, and CVSS
* Strong understanding of security frameworks and NIST standards
* Appropriate security-based qualification; CISSP, GCIH (or demonstrated skills and ability to obtain certification) – more than one certification preferred.
* Public cloud certifications (or demonstrated skills and ability to obtain certification)
* Expert experience with security incident handling processes, procedures and methodologies.
* Expert technical experience with identifying and mitigating a breadth of attacks such as DDoS, web application, DNS, and other network attacks.
* Expert knowledge of common security vulnerabilities and the ability to judge their severity
* Expert experience with working security incidents at corporate production environments
* Experience working with network and packet analysis tools
* BA/BS degree or equivalent experience
* Expert knowledge with Web Application Firewalls, Firewalls and IPS/IDS
* Expert experience with network vulnerability scanners
* Expert OS hardening and security best practices
* Knowledge of common Malware types and infection vectors
* Expert knowledge in threat modeling, secure architecture, secure coding practices, and security testing.

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Hands on technical experience with and very knowledgeable on LAN/WAN operations, and/or networking hardware required
* CVE and CERT experience
* Expert knowledge of security offensive/defensive techniques and methodologies.
* Expert understanding of security attack/defense methodologies (e.g. DNS, network TCP/IP, SSL and HTTP)
* Expert understanding and working knowledge of TCP/IP, SSL, DNS, HTTP, and common protocols.
* Coding experience – having, in addition to proficiency in Python, knowledge in other scripting languages
* Understanding of the underlying mechanisms for security vulnerabilities at a code and assembly level, e.g. buffer overflows, input sanitisation
* Knowledge of network and security monitoring tools
* Familiarity with load balancers, WAF’s and common network architectures
* Working knowledge of standard UNIX/Linux command line tools
* Hands-on technical experience with public clouds (e.g. AWS, Azure, or GCP), and container-based deployments and orchestration tools (e.g. Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Ansible)
* Knowledge of microservice architecture, modern application architecture, and API security
* Ability to generate new training and knowledge sharing content via various delivery methods
* Able to work with moderate supervision
* Proven track record in a team environment
* Analytical thinker with strong attention to detail
* Must be able to read, write, and speak English fluently, including technical concepts and terminology.
* Must be able to relay technical information to customers with varying skill levels
* Ability to create attack Proof of Concepts
* Experience with incident tracking software, Seibel experience a plus

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:**
Duties are performed in a normal office environment while sitting at a desk or computer table. Duties require the ability to utilize a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material. Duties may require the ability to travel via automobile or airplane, approximately 20% of the time spent traveling. Some datacenter/lab work as well. Duties may require the ability to lift 50 lbs enabling them to rack our controllers in customer locations or our lab. This role may require work outside of core business hours, including early morning, late evening, overnight, weekends, and/or holidays as needed. There will be a requirement to participate in an on-call rotation
  
  
Some travel may be required, a current passport is required
  
  
This role is regional – Americas, EMEA and APJ.

description:

Their India centre is located in Hyderabad, serves as a key strategic hub and comprises India’s top-tier tech talent. Deutsche Börse Group in India is composed of a team of capital market engineers forming the backbone of financial markets worldwide.

**Field of Activity:**

* As part of an Identity and Access Management (IAM) service team, you will support a client’s SailPoint IdentityIQ implementation, focusing on application onboarding and connector bug fixing. Your role will involve developing and maintaining SailPoint connectors, troubleshooting integration issues, and ensuring seamless application integration with the IAM platform. This position contributes to the client’s identity governance by ensuring secure, efficient, and policy-compliant application access management. You will collaborate closely with client stakeholders and application teams to drive continuous improvement in onboarding processes and connector functionality.
* We are seeking a skilled SailPoint Developer to join our IAM services team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, configuring, and maintaining SailPoint IdentityIQ connectors for application onboarding, as well as resolving connector-related issues through debugging and bug fixing. This includes designing and implementing integration solutions, validating connector functionality, and ensuring compliance with identity governance policies. You will troubleshoot technical issues, document solutions, and provide actionable recommendations to application teams. The role requires strong technical expertise in SailPoint development, problem-solving skills, and the ability to interpret complex IAM requirements. Familiarity with identity governance frameworks and integration protocols (e.g., SCIM, REST, SOAP) is essential. You will also utilize ticketing and development tools to manage and track tasks effectively. Effective communication with client stakeholders and internal teams is a critical component of this position.

**Tasks/Responsibilities:**

title: Business Information Security Expert, Finance
description:
**Summary**
Location: Hyderabad, India
  
  
Internal job title: Associate Director DDIT ISC FM&A Compliance
  
  
**About The Role:**
Finance relies on a complex portfolio of applications and technology platforms supporting critical business processes, data and reporting. Protecting this environment requires strong Information Security expertise combined with business judgement, effective governance and close partnership with the teams that own, operate and transform these solutions.
  
  
As a Business Information Security Expert (BISE) supporting Finance, you will act as a trusted Information Security adviser and business partner for a portfolio of Finance applications, platforms and initiatives.
  
  
You will work with Finance, DD&IT, application owners, project teams and Information Security specialists to ensure security requirements are understood, material risks are identified and managed, and appropriate controls are incorporated throughout the application lifecycle.
  
  
This is not simply about identifying control gaps or enforcing requirements. You will need to understand the technology and business context, determine what genuinely matters, translate technical findings into business risk and help stakeholders find practical, proportionate solutions.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Application Security & Governance: Provide Information Security guidance and oversight for assigned Finance applications, platforms and initiatives throughout their lifecycle.
* Risk & Security Posture Management: Identify, assess and communicate material security risks, vulnerabilities, control gaps and policy exceptions, helping stakeholders prioritize and drive appropriate remediation.
* Security by Design: Engage with projects and significant application changes to ensure security requirements are considered early and appropriately incorporated into solutions.
* Identity & Data Protection: Provide guidance on security areas including identity and access management, privileged access, sensitive information, data protection and application integrations.
* Third-Party Risk: Identify and help manage security risks associated with vendors, technology providers and externally delivered services.
* Audit & Assurance: Support security-related assurance, audit and compliance activities and help application teams address identified gaps.
* Security SME Coordination: Recognize when specialist expertise is required, engage the appropriate Information Security or Cybersecurity teams and translate their findings into practical actions.
* Business Partnership: Build strong relationships across Finance, DD&IT and Information Security, constructively challenging where necessary while helping stakeholders achieve business objectives securely.
* Executive Communication: Translate complex security matters into clear business impact, recommendations and decisions.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring risks and systemic weaknesses across the portfolio and help improve security governance and ways of working.

****Essential Requirements:****

* 8+ years of experience with strong understanding and knowledge of enterprise Information Security and Cybersecurity, with experience in compliance, governance and controls aspects.
* Ability to assess risk across applications, infrastructure, cloud, identity, data, AI tools and third parties.
* Strong analytical, investigative and critical-thinking skills, pragmatic proportionate and risk-based decision-making.
* Ability to rapidly understand unfamiliar technologies, companies and business environments, and judgement to distinguish material risk from technical noise.
* Confidence making recommendations when information is incomplete, ambiguous or evolving.
* Excellent written, verbal and executive communication skills, with strong stakeholder-management and influencing capabilities.
* Ability to work autonomously while knowing when specialist expertise or escalation is required.
* Intellectual curiosity, ability to learn quickly and comfort operating in fast-moving, complex environments.

****Desirable Requirements:****

title: Senior DevSecOps / Platform Security Engineer
description:
**About the role**

We are hiring a hands-on Security Engineer, a DevSecOps / Platform Security Engineer to build the shared "secure paved road" for a portfolio of GenAI applications delivered across several product streams. Your job is to make the secure way the default way: run security tools and remediate for and with the project team findings in IaC, back- and front-ends, build reusable pipeline, container, and dependency-management templates that every stream inherits, so security is built in at delivery time rather than bolted on afterward.

**What you'll do**

* Run advanced security tools and manage the results.
* Threat models the application with the team.
* Improve on CI/CD security.
* Remediate security findings.
* Bar-raise software supply chain security.
* Package everything as reusable templates plus short "how and why" guidance so the paved road spreads without you in the loop for every repository.

**What you'll bring (required)**

* Senior-level engineering maturity — sets standards, drives adoption across teams, and owns security outcomes end-to-end together with the team and higher level security leadership.
* Strong, current software engineering / coding ability — you write and review Python code, not only edit configuration. A portfolio, repository, or code sample you can walk us through.
* Hands-on CI/CD engineering, ideally Jenkins (pipelines and shared libraries).
* Container security in practice: multi-stage, digest-pinned, non-root Docker images; understanding of image attack surface.
* Python and/or Node dependency & supply-chain know-how: lockfiles, hash pinning, safe index resolution, dependency scanning.
* AWS security engineering: least-privilege IAM, secrets management, and hardening of container/serverless workloads.
* Practical secret management and secret scanning, including pre-commit gating.
* Experience integrating SAST / SCA / IaC scanning into pipelines as enforced gates, with sensible false-positive tuning.
* Solid TLS / PKI fundamentals.
* Comfort using AI coding agents (e.g. Kiro, Claude Code, Codex) as a daily tool to ship faster — with the judgment to review and verify their output.

**Strongly preferred — Security Credentials**

* AWS Security Specialty certification (AWS Certified Security – Specialty) is highly desirable.
* Alternatively, other strong industry security credentials — e.g. OSCP, CISSP, or equivalent deep technical security or security management credentials.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in a regulated environment (HCLS / pharma / GxP / HIPAA / GDPR).
* GenAI / LLM application exposure: managed model endpoints (e.g. Amazon Bedrock), retrieval-augmented generation, and the security considerations that come with them.
* Application-security depth (authN/authZ, tenant isolation, common web vulnerabilities).
* Familiarity with Bitbucket, an artifact registry, and Helm.

title: Security Engineer
description:
**About Us**
CDK Global is a leading provider of cloud-based software to dealerships and Original Equipment Manufacturers (“OEMs”) across automotive and related industries. The Company’s cloud-based, software as a service (“SaaS”) platform enables dealerships to manage their end-to-end business operations including the acquisition, sale, financing, insuring, repair, and maintenance of vehicles. By automating and streamlining critical workflows, the integrated platform of modern solutions enables dealers to sell and service more vehicles by creating simple and convenient experiences for customers and improves their financial and operational performance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As a Platform Security Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and securing our cloud and on-premises compute infrastructure. You will be responsible for implementing and maintaining robust security solutions for our Cloud environments. This role requires a deep understanding of security principles, cloud technologies and infrastructure as code practices. As a Platform Security Engineer, you will participate in security reviews, design and develop innovative security solutions and tools to enhance our security posture and visibility.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Leadership & Technical Strategy**

* Architect the North Star: Define and establish the multi-year cloud security roadmap, aligning technical debt reduction with business velocity.
* Strategic Influence: Partner with business stakeholders to ensure security is a core architectural pillar and a fundamental requirement in all product development.
* CoE Leadership: Provide technical leadership to the Security Center of Excellence (CoE), aligning the Security Champions’ roadmap with platform engineering goals to ensure a consistent security posture across all environments.
* Data-Driven Governance: Define high-level KPIs (e.g., MTTR, Policy Coverage, Identity Risk scores) to provide executive visibility and drive cross-functional accountability for platform risk.

**Cloud Security Architecture & Engineering**

* Scalable Governance: Architect and govern multi-tenant cloud environments using standardized landing zone patterns (e.g., CAF or Control Tower). Establish global guardrails that balance developer velocity with enterprise security requirements.
* Identity Governance: Architect a Zero Trust identity ecosystem centering on automated Conditional Access, Just-In-Time (JIT) elevation via Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Workload Identity Federation to eliminate standing high-privileged access.
* Zero Trust Networking: Oversee the transition to a Zero Trust network architecture. Implement deep-defense strategies including private connectivity, centralized egress/ingress control, and application-layer protection.

**Policy-as-Code & IaC Governance**

* Scalable Guardrails: Transition from manual reviews to automated governance using Policy-as-Code (e.g., Azure Policy, OPA) to enforce "Security by Default" across the infrastructure lifecycle.
* Standardized Modules: Develop and maintain a library of "Hardened" Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) modules to provide pre-configured, compliant templates for common cloud services.
* Drift Management: Implement automated detection and remediation systems to identify and resolve infrastructure drift across cloud subscriptions.

**Automated Remediation and Orchestration**

* Autonomous Remediation: Design event-driven automation and SOAR playbooks to identify and remediate configuration drift and routine threats in real-time, enabling a "Self-Healing" infrastructure.
* Shift-Left Architecture: Integrate automated security "gates" into CI/CD pipelines, including IaC scanning and container analysis, ensuring security feedback is delivered directly to engineers within their existing workflows.
* Operational Efficiency: Develop custom automation and scripting to eliminate manual security tasks, focusing on reducing the "Mean Time to Remediate" (MTTR) for critical platform vulnerabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Technical Architecture & Engineering**

* Advanced Cloud Mastery: 4+ years of experience in Infrastructure or Security Engineering, with a deep architectural focus on Azure Enterprise environments (Management Groups, ALZ, and complex networking).
* Identity & Zero Trust Expert: Proven track record of designing and implementing Zero Trust identity frameworks, specifically leveraging Microsoft Entra ID (PIM, Conditional Access) and Workload Identity Federation at scale.
* Systems Design: Strong ability to architect "Security-by-Design" patterns that solve for the entire lifecycle of a resource, from initial IaC commit to runtime protection.

**Automation & Code Proficiency**

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Expert: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform (including module development and provider management) and cloud-native templates (Bicep/ARM/AWS CloudFormation).
* Engineering Mindset: Proficiency in Python, Go, or PowerShell for building custom security tooling, automation, and API integrations. Experience with Policy-as-Code frameworks (e.g., OPA/Rego, Azure Policy) is highly preferred.
* Pipeline Security: Hands-on experience architecting security gates and automated scanning within GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines.

**Leadership & Strategic Impact**

* Strategic Influence: Experience leading large-scale technical initiatives that require cross-functional alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders to align security goals with business priorities.
* Mentorship & CoE: Demonstrated experience by mentoring senior engineers and providing technical steering within a Security Center of Excellence (CoE).
* Metric-Driven Governance: Ability to define and report on technical risk through data (MTTR, posture trends) to drive organizational accountability.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Industry Frameworks: Deep familiarity with the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Well-Architected Frameworks.
* Container Security: Extensive experience securing Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) and containerized workloads, including service mesh and admission controllers.
* Advanced Certification: Professional-level certifications such as AZ-500, SC-100 (Cybersecurity Architect), CISSP, or CCSP.
* Security Platform Expertise: Experience architecting enterprise-scale CNAPP, XDR, or SOAR solutions (e.g., Palo Alto/Cortex, Microsoft Sentinel).

title: Cloud AI Security - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
SeniorConsultant - Cloud AI Security
  
  
Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.
  
  
Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
  
  

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
  
  
**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
* CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently.

title: Lead - Captive Operations
description:
**About The Company**
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
  
**Job Description - L2 SD-WAN Engineer**
Job Title: L2 SD-WAN Engineer
  
  
Location: Hyderabad
  
  
Experience: Minimum 5-7 years
  
  
**Qualification**
B.E./B.Tech./MCA with minimum 5 years of relevant experience
  
  
OR BCA/B.Sc.-IT with minimum 7 years of relevant experience
  
  
**Certifications Required**
OEM certification in at least one SD-WAN technology is preferred/mandatory, such as:
  
  
Cisco SD-WAN
  
  
Fortinet Secure SD-WAN
  
  
Versa SD-WAN
  
  
CCNA/CCNP, NSE/FCP, Versa Certified or equivalent networking/SD-WAN certification will be an added advantage.
  
  
CEH certified
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly capable and experienced L2 SD-WAN Engineer to join the Network Operations team at the client location. The candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day operation, monitoring, troubleshooting, configuration, maintenance, and implementation of multi-vendor SD-WAN environments.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on experience in SD-WAN technologies and enterprise networking, with the ability to work across different OEM platforms such as Cisco SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, and Versa SD-WAN. The candidate will work closely with L1, L3, Network, Security, ISP, and OEM teams to ensure high availability, optimal performance, and secure connectivity across data centers, branch offices, cloud environments, and remote locations.
  
  
The candidate should have a good understanding of SD-WAN architecture, centralized orchestration, underlay and overlay networks, routing protocols, VPN/VRF, IPsec tunnels, application-aware routing, QoS, high availability, and Internet/MPLS connectivity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Monitor and manage multi-vendor SD-WAN infrastructure, including Cisco, Fortinet, and Versa SD-WAN solutions.
  
  
Perform day-to-day operational support and troubleshooting of SD-WAN devices, controllers, orchestrators, and management platforms.
  
  
Monitor the health and availability of SD-WAN overlay and underlay networks, including WAN links, tunnels, controllers, and edge devices.
  
  
Troubleshoot SD-WAN connectivity issues involving MPLS, Internet, broadband, LTE/4G/5G, and other WAN transport technologies.
  
  
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to IPsec tunnels, overlay connectivity, routing, VPN/VRF, BGP, OSPF, static routes, and route propagation.
  
  
Analyze SD-WAN alarms, events, logs, and performance metrics to identify and resolve network incidents.
  
  
Configure and troubleshoot application-aware routing, traffic steering, SLA-based path selection, QoS, and bandwidth utilization.
  
  
Perform configuration and policy changes through centralized SD-WAN management and orchestration platforms.
  
  
Implement SD-WAN policies, templates, profiles, routing configurations, security policies, and application-based traffic steering as per approved requirements.
  
  
Support deployment and implementation of new SD-WAN sites, branches, data centers, and cloud connectivity.
  
  
Participate in SD-WAN migration projects, including migration from traditional MPLS-based networks to SD-WAN solutions.
  
  
Perform SD-WAN edge device onboarding, provisioning, configuration, and validation activities.
  
  
Support integration of SD-WAN with existing network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, routers, switches, Internet gateways, and cloud platforms.
  
  
Perform health checks, configuration backups, software upgrades, firmware upgrades, and patch management for SD-WAN infrastructure.
  
  
Troubleshoot performance issues related to latency, packet loss, jitter, bandwidth utilization, and application performance.
  
  
Coordinate with ISPs and telecom service providers for resolution of WAN link-related incidents and performance issues.
  
  
Work with L1 and L3 teams to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex SD-WAN incidents and service-impacting issues.
  
  
Participate in the incident, problem, and change management processes and ensure compliance with defined ITIL processes and SLAs.
  
  
Validate and implement approved SD-WAN change requests, including impact assessment, implementation planning, rollback planning, and post-change validation.
  
  
Support SD-WAN high-availability configurations, redundancy testing, failover testing, and DR drills.
  
  
Perform planned and emergency changes during maintenance windows and ensure proper post-change validation.
  
  
Support troubleshooting and implementation of SD-WAN security features, including IPsec encryption, segmentation, secure connectivity, and integration with next-generation firewalls.
  
  
Support network segmentation using VPN/VRF and SD-WAN segmentation policies based on business and security requirements.
  
  
Perform configuration-level remediation activities identified through vulnerability assessments, security audits, and compliance reviews.
  
  
Analyze and act upon OEM advisories, security vulnerabilities, bug notifications, and recommended software upgrades relevant to SD-WAN platforms.
  
  
Maintain updated network diagrams, configuration documents, implementation documents, SOPs, MOPs, and troubleshooting guides.
  
  
Create and maintain knowledge base articles for recurring SD-WAN incidents, known errors, and standard troubleshooting procedures.
  
  
Prepare operational reports covering SD-WAN availability, incidents, link performance, SLA compliance, capacity utilization, and recurring issues.
  
  
Generate reports and dashboards related to SD-WAN health, network performance, incidents, and service trends.
  
  
Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for operational reporting, data analysis, and management presentations.
  
  
Coordinate with OEM support teams for complex technical issues and track cases through resolution.
  
  
Participate in technology refresh, capacity expansion, and SD-WAN optimization initiatives.
  
  
Continuously optimize SD-WAN configurations and policies to improve network availability, application performance, and bandwidth utilization.
  
  
Ensure compliance with defined security policies, operational procedures, change management processes, and SLA requirements.
  
  
Maintain awareness of the latest SD-WAN features, technologies, best practices, and product enhancements from Cisco, Fortinet, Versa, and other relevant OEMs.
  
  
**Technical Skills / Desired Competencies**
Strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking and SD-WAN operations.
  
  
Good understanding of SD-WAN architecture, control plane, data plane, management plane, and orchestration components.
  
  
**Hands-on Experience With One Or More Of**
Cisco SD-WAN / Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN
  
  
Fortinet Secure SD-WAN / FortiGate
  
  
Versa SD-WAN
  
  
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, NAT, DNS, DHCP, ACL, IPsec, GRE, and routing concepts.
  
  
Good hands-on knowledge of BGP, OSPF, static routing, route redistribution, and routing policies.
  
  
Good understanding of MPLS, Internet, broadband, LTE/4G/5G and hybrid WAN connectivity.
  
  
Experience in troubleshooting IPsec tunnels, overlay/underlay connectivity, routing issues, packet loss, latency, jitter, and application performance.
  
  
Knowledge of QoS, application-aware routing, traffic engineering, and dynamic path selection.
  
  
Understanding of network security concepts, including firewalls, segmentation, secure tunnels, encryption, and security policies.
  
  
Experience with SD-WAN monitoring, centralized management, orchestration, and analytics platforms.
  
  
Ability to perform packet-level troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark, ping, traceroute, and vendor-specific troubleshooting utilities.
  
  
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to handle critical network incidents under SLA-driven operations.
  
  
Ability to work in a multi-vendor environment and adapt to different OEM technologies and operational processes.
  
  
Strong communication and coordination skills for working with L1/L3 teams, OEMs, ISPs, and client stakeholders.
  
  
Willingness to work in 24 7 operations / rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays, as required by business needs.
  
  
Strong documentation and reporting skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio or equivalent network diagramming tools.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Experience in large enterprise or managed services environments.
  
  
Experience supporting geographically distributed branch networks.
  
  
Experience in SD-WAN implementation, migration, and rollout projects.
  
  
Experience in multi-vendor SD-WAN environments involving Cisco, Fortinet, and Versa.
  
  
Experience in managing critical incidents and participating in major incident management processes.
  
  
Experience in network automation, API-based configuration, or SD-WAN orchestration is an added advantage.
  
  
Experience working with ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management processes.

title: Specialist, Cybersecurity - Insider Threat Response Analyst
description:
**Specialist, Cybersecurity – Insider Threat Response Analyst**

**Position Summary**

The
**Specialist, Cybersecurity**
supports Nationwide’s
**Insider Threat Program**
by monitoring and triaging alerts related to potentially suspicious employee, contractor, and user activity. The role helps identify possible
**policy violations, unauthorized activity, and data loss or exfiltration risks**
by reviewing alerts, analyzing logs and contextual information, gathering evidence, documenting cases, and escalating validated concerns to the appropriate investigation team. The team’s primary monitoring tool is
**Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management**
, with additional detections in a
**Palo Alto SIEM**
environment.

**Role Focus Areas**

The hiring team considers two related profiles. Candidates may align more strongly with one focus area:

**1. Insider Risk Monitoring and Alert Triage**

* Monitor and review
  **Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management**
  alerts.
* Triage alerts and validate whether user activity appears suspicious or requires further review.
* Gather relevant context and supporting evidence, apply sound judgment, and distinguish potentially risky activity from legitimate or personal activity where appropriate.
* Create and document investigation cases, then escalate validated cases to the deeper investigation team.
* Review activity involving potential
  **data exfiltration, suspicious external sharing, unusual use of tools, policy violations**
  , and other insider-risk indicators.

**2. Insider Threat Detection and SIEM Analysis**

* Review and analyze alerts and detections in the
  **Palo Alto SIEM**
  environment.
* Search and correlate logs to assess suspicious activity and investigate security events.
* Review existing detection logic and recommend tuning to improve detection quality and reduce false positives.
* Support the maintenance and improvement of
  **queries, dashboards, automation, and investigation workflows**
  .
* Use query-based analysis to identify patterns, validate detections, and provide recommendations for improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor insider-risk and security alerts generated by
  **Microsoft Purview**
  and other relevant security tools.
* Analyze
  **user activity, authentication events, endpoint activity, and security logs**
  to validate suspicious behavior.
* Recognize potential
  **data theft or exfiltration, unauthorized access, misuse of privileges, policy violations**
  , and suspicious use of applications or tools.
* Correlate information across systems and use contextual judgment to determine whether an alert should be documented, closed, or escalated.
* Gather supporting evidence and maintain clear, accurate case documentation.
* Escalate validated cases to the appropriate team for deeper investigation; this role does not necessarily own end-to-end investigations.
* For SIEM-focused work, review detections, develop or refine queries, and recommend tuning or dashboard improvements.
* Support automation and continuous improvement of monitoring and investigation workflows where appropriate.
* Work collaboratively with cybersecurity, threat intelligence, and relevant partner teams.

**Qualification Criteria**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* BE / BTech with 5-8 years of experience with strong
  **Foundational**
  **cybersecurity experience**
  in a SOC, security monitoring, cybersecurity analysis, incident response, threat hunting, or a related role.
* Experience reviewing security alerts and investigating or validating suspicious activity; candidates should demonstrate an
  **investigative mindset**
  rather than only passive alert monitoring.
* Hands-on exposure to
  **SIEM tools**
  and the ability to review alerts, search logs, and correlate security events. Relevant platforms may include
  **Palo Alto, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, Cortex**
  , or comparable tools.
* **Log analysis**
  experience, including security, authentication, endpoint, or user activity logs.
* Working knowledge of
  **Windows and Linux**
  operating systems; macOS exposure is beneficial.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including
  **TCP/IP, DNS**
  , and common security-related communications.
* Ability to use judgment, document findings clearly, and follow appropriate escalation processes.

**Preferred Skills**

* Direct experience with
  **Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management**
  or an
  **Insider Threat Program**
  .
* **SQL**
  or other query-writing experience for security event and log analysis.
* **XQL**
  experience, particularly for Palo Alto SIEM detection analysis.
* **PowerShell or Python scripting**
  for investigation support, log parsing, or automation. Scripting is beneficial but is not a strict screening knockout.
* **Detection tuning, dashboard improvement, security analytics, or threat hunting**
  experience.
* **Digital forensics, evidence collection and preservation, cloud security, behavioral analytics**
  , and familiarity with
  **MITRE ATT&CK**
  .

Additional Information

**Role Context and Candidate Calibration**

* The
  **triage-focused profile**
  is centered on daily alert review, validation, evidence gathering, and case creation.
* The
  **SIEM-focused profile**
  requires stronger query and detection-analysis capability, including reviewing and tuning detections.
* The role is part of a broader team; deeper investigations are handed over to the relevant investigation group.

**Microsoft Purview**
is the primary tool for current insider-risk monitoring, and
**Palo Alto**
is used for SIEM detections.

description:
**Job Description – Senior Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist**
**Experience:**
8–10 Years
  
  
**Function:**
Cybersecurity – Incident Response / DFIR
  
  
**Role Level:**
Senior
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist with 8–10 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience to manage and investigate security incidents across enterprise environments.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents, including triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), malware analysis, and digital forensic analysis. The role also requires strong customer-facing skills to lead incident discussions, provide regular updates, explain technical findings, and present investigation outcomes and recommendations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Incident Response & Investigation**

* Take end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents from initial detection through closure.
* Lead investigation of Critical, High, and complex security incidents and coordinate response activities across relevant teams.
* Perform incident triage, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
* Investigate incidents involving ransomware, malware, phishing, account compromise, credential theft, data exfiltration, insider threats, web attacks, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and other advanced threats.
* Analyze security alerts and correlate information across EDR, SIEM, network, identity, cloud, email, and other security technologies.
* Develop incident timelines and determine the attack vector, affected assets, compromised accounts, attacker activity, persistence mechanisms, and overall impact.
* Identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), attacker Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), and map findings to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Coordinate with SOC, Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, IT, Cloud, Network, IAM, Application, Legal, and other stakeholders during major incidents.

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**

* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis for security incidents.
* Determine the initial attack vector, contributing factors, security/control gaps, and reasons existing preventive or detective controls did not stop or detect the activity earlier.
* Conduct post-incident reviews and lessons-learned sessions.
* Develop clear corrective and preventive actions based on investigation findings.
* Track remediation recommendations with relevant stakeholders through closure.
* Prepare comprehensive RCA reports suitable for technical teams, management, and customers.

**Malware Analysis**

* Perform static and dynamic malware analysis to understand malicious file behavior and capabilities.
* Analyze suspicious executables, scripts, PowerShell commands, documents, URLs, and other artifacts.
* Identify malware persistence mechanisms, command-and-control activity, network indicators, file-system changes, registry modifications, and related behaviors.
* Extract IOCs and behavioral indicators for threat hunting and detection engineering.
* Perform malware sandboxing and behavioral analysis where required.
* Provide recommendations for detection, containment, and prevention based on malware-analysis findings.

**Digital Forensics**

* Perform digital forensic investigations on endpoints and other relevant systems.
* Analyze Windows/Linux artifacts, event logs, file systems, registry artifacts, browser artifacts, authentication logs, memory artifacts, and other forensic evidence.
* Perform disk and memory analysis where required.
* Collect and preserve digital evidence following appropriate forensic procedures and chain-of-custody requirements.
* Build forensic timelines and reconstruct attacker activities.
* Determine the scope and impact of compromise using forensic evidence.
* Document forensic findings clearly and maintain investigation evidence appropriately.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key technical point of contact for customers during cybersecurity incidents.
* Lead incident calls and communicate investigation progress, impact, containment status, risks, and next steps.
* Provide timely and accurate incident updates to customers and internal leadership.
* Translate complex technical investigation findings into clear business-level communication.
* Manage customer expectations during high-severity and time-sensitive incidents.
* Present RCA and forensic investigation findings to customers and senior stakeholders.
* Handle technical questions and confidently explain investigation methodology, evidence, conclusions, and recommendations.
* Coordinate with multiple internal and customer teams to drive incidents toward timely resolution.

**Incident Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare detailed incident investigation reports, including:
* Maintain accurate incident records, evidence, investigation notes, and supporting documentation.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of Incident Response playbooks, SOPs, investigation procedures, and escalation processes.
* Executive summary
* Incident timeline
* Scope and impact
* Root cause
* Attack vector
* IOCs and TTPs
* Investigation findings
* Containment and remediation actions
* Control gaps
* Corrective and preventive recommendations
* Lessons learned

**Required Technical Skills**
The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in:
  
  

* Cybersecurity Incident Response / DFIR
* Security Incident Investigation
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Digital Forensics
* Malware Analysis
* Threat Hunting
* Endpoint and Network Investigation
* Windows and Linux Forensics
* Disk and Memory Analysis
* Log Analysis and Timeline Reconstruction
* IOC and TTP Analysis
* MITRE ATT&CK Framework
* SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or similar
* EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, or similar
* Network security technologies including Firewall, IDS/IPS, Proxy, DNS, VPN, and WAF
* Cloud security investigation across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP environments
* Identity and authentication-related investigations
* Email and phishing investigations
* Forensic and malware-analysis tools such as Volatility, Autopsy, FTK, EnCase, Wireshark, Sysinternals, YARA, Ghidra, IDA, or equivalent tools
* Scripting/automation using Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies would be an advantage.

**Required Experience**

* 8–10 years of overall cybersecurity experience, with significant hands-on experience in Incident Response, DFIR, SOC, Threat Hunting, or related security domains.
* Demonstrated experience independently handling complex and high-severity cybersecurity incidents.
* Strong experience conducting RCA and presenting investigation findings.
* Hands-on experience with malware and forensic investigations.
* Experience handling customer-facing security incidents and leading technical/customer incident calls.
* Experience coordinating investigations involving multiple technical and business teams.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during Critical/High-severity incidents.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

**Communication & Leadership Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead incident bridges/calls during critical incidents.
* Strong documentation and report-writing skills.
* Ability to take ownership, make investigation decisions, and drive incidents to closure.
* Ability to mentor junior Incident Response/SOC analysts and provide technical guidance during investigations.

* Sonatype Nexus Repository (Nexus IQ)

Job Title: Endpoint Engineering Specialist – macOS & Jamf

Location: Hyderabad

Position Type: Full-time (Individual Contributor)

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Endpoint Engineering Specialist to own and engineer the enterprise Apple endpoint environment. The role focuses on managing, securing, automating, and optimizing macOS devices and Jamf Pro, ensuring reliable device provisioning, application deployment, security compliance, and lifecycle management across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

Own and administer Jamf Pro, including policies, configuration profiles, Smart Groups, Extension Attributes, packages, and Self Service.

Manage Apple device enrollment and lifecycle workflows using Apple Business Manager (ABM) and Automated Device Enrollment (ADE).

Design and implement macOS configuration standards, security baselines, and compliance policies.

Automate endpoint management tasks using Bash/Zsh scripting and Jamf APIs.

Manage macOS application packaging, deployment, updates, and patch management.

Implement FileVault encryption, certificate management, identity integrations, and endpoint security controls.

Troubleshoot complex Jamf, MDM, enrollment, application deployment, and macOS-related issues.

Lead major incident investigations, root cause analysis, remediation, and preventive actions.

Maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, deployment standards, and compliance evidence.

Drive automation, standardization, platform improvements, and enterprise macOS lifecycle management.

Required Skills:

Strong hands-on experience with enterprise macOS administration and engineering.

Advanced expertise in Jamf Pro, including policies, profiles, Smart Groups, Extension Attributes, and device enrollment.

Proficiency in Bash/Zsh scripting, application packaging, deployment automation, and Jamf API integrations.

Strong knowledge of Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, MDM, and device lifecycle management.

Experience with FileVault, macOS security baselines, certificates, compliance, and troubleshooting.

Understanding of enterprise identity integrations, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, and endpoint security.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Nice to Have:

Jamf Pro Administrator or Jamf Pro Expert certification.

Experience with Jamf Connect, Jamf Protect, and Platform SSO.

Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and enterprise security integrations.

Experience managing large-scale or global Apple endpoint environments.

Experience with macOS migrations, automation, ITSM processes, and major incident management.

description:

**Senior Specialist, Private Cloud platform (Virtualization)**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. Manage and optimize virtual machines and host environments, ensuring high availability and performance.

Monitor and troubleshoot VMware performance issues, applying root cause analysis for effective resolution.

Manage Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPO), and Domain Name System (DNS) services to ensure seamless integration and security.
  
  
Develop, implement, and enforce best practices for Windows security, patch management, and system updates.
  
  
Automate system administration tasks using PowerShell scripting to enhance efficiency and reduce manual interventions.
