Provide technical support and guidance to team members and end-users on VMware and Windows-related issues.
  
  
Develop and maintain system documentation, including architecture diagrams, configurations, and operational procedures.
  
  
**Performance Monitoring and Optimization**
Utilize monitoring tools to assess and optimize the performance of VMware and Windows environments.
  
  
Identify opportunities for improvement in system performance, availability, and scalability.

* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 7+ years of experience in VMware technologies and Windows Server administration.
* VMware Certified Professional (VCP) and Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE) certifications preferred.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts, virtualization best practices, and server hardware.
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and familiarity with automation tools.

Our technology teams operate as business partners, proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities. We collaborate internationally to deliver services and solutions that help everyone be more productive and enable innovation.

We are known as Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. title: System Administrator
description:
Winsupply is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented IT Systems & Security Administrator (L2) with 2 to 4 years of experience to support our hybrid enterprise infrastructure and frontline security operations. In this role, you will safeguard core digital assets across multi-regional environments—monitoring endpoint and web application security events, deploying critical system patches, and responding to operational incidents. Alongside security monitoring, you will play a key role in maintaining system uptime, verifying data backups, and supporting database and network health. This is an excellent opportunity for a technical professional looking to expand their expertise across both enterprise systems administration and frontline SecOps within a collaborative global team.

In this role, you will be the operational backbone of our technical operations, ensuring high availability across servers, networks, and databases while executing critical backup routines and disaster recovery procedures. In addition, you will act as the frontline responder for security alerts (EDR/XDR and SIEM), vulnerability patching, and off-hours operational disruptions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.Database Maintenance & Monitoring**

* Monitor relational database health, CPU utilization, disk space, memory utilization, connection pool limits, and blocking locks (e.g., DB2, SQL Server, MariaDB, or MongoDB).
* Track replication status, high-availability cluster health, and alert on replication lag or database service interruptions.
* Perform operational maintenance tasks including checking table bloat, space allocation, and executing standard service restart playbooks during scheduled off-hours.

**2.Backup, Disaster Recovery & Storage Management**

* Oversee and verify automated daily, weekly, and monthly backup schedules across enterprise systems, databases, and cloud/on-premise storage.
* Actively investigate backup failures, resolve storage capacity bottlenecks, and re-trigger failed backup jobs.
* Participate in scheduled Disaster Recovery (DR) drills and execute routine restoration validations to ensure Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) and Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) are strictly maintained.

**3.Network & Operating System Administration**

* Administer Windows Server and Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS) environments, including user access, OS patching, disk space management, and system services.
* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity issues, including DNS resolution failures, DHCP scopes, routing issues, and VPN tunnel drops.
* Verify firewall traffic rules, monitor reverse proxy/load balancer health checks, and manage SSL/TLS certificate renewals to prevent service outages.

**4.Endpoint & Web Application Security Monitoring**

* Monitor enterprise endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) platforms (e.g., Palo Alto Cortex XDR, Defender for Endpoint).
* Triage high-severity alerts, including
  **WildFire Malware**
  sandbox verifications,
  **Local Analysis Malware**
  , and suspicious process executions.
* Execute frontline containment procedures, including host network isolation and account lockdowns following established security playbooks.
* Monitor Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and API gateways for abnormal traffic spikes, suspicious request patterns, and Layer 7 anomalies.

**5.Vulnerability & System Patch Management**

* Track infrastructure and endpoint vulnerabilities across Linux, Windows, and third-party software.
* Plan, test, and deploy monthly OS patches, kernel updates, and critical security hotfixes during approved off-hours maintenance windows.
* Coordinate patch rollbacks and mitigation steps if updates conflict with production databases or application dependencies.

**6.Incident Response & SIEM Monitoring**

* Serve as the primary responder for off-hours system outages, database alerts, network interruptions, and high-priority security incidents.
* Monitor enterprise SIEM queues (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel) for suspicious authentication attempts, brute-force patterns, and privilege escalation.
* Facilitate swift triage, coordinate with upstream engineering/DBA leads when needed, and lead post-incident Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reporting.

**7.Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain up-to-date Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational runbooks, and shift handover records.
* Track and report on key operational SLAs, including backup success rates, patch compliance percentages, and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).

**Candidate Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:**
  2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in Systems Administration, Infrastructure Support, or an integrated SysAdmin / SecOps role.
* **Core Technical Competencies:**
* **OS & Networking:**
  Proficient in Linux and Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS, TCP/IP troubleshooting, and basic firewall configurations.
* **Database & Backups:**
  Hands-on experience checking database services and locks, combined with practical exposure to enterprise backup solutions (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, AWS Backup, native DB dumps).
* **Security Tools:**
  Practical familiarity with EDR/XDR consoles (Palo Alto Cortex XDR preferred) and SIEM alert monitoring.
* **Scripting (Advantageous):**
  Working knowledge of Bash, PowerShell, or Python to automate basic health checks and log reviews.
* **Work Style:**
  Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset under incident conditions.
* **Flexibility:**
  Willingness to work in rotational shifts and participate in scheduled off-hours/weekend on-call rotations.

**Qualifications/Experience**

* Associate or Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Network+, or (ISC)² SSCP are preferred.
* Familiarity with web application security concepts and common vulnerability scanners (e.g., Nessus, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).
* Basic scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automation and log processing are a plus.
* Experience operating within a SIEM or Security Operations Center (SOC) environment is advantageous.

**Job Description 1 IT Risk Analyst — Risk Operations (3–5 Years Experience)**
**Position Summary**
The IT Risk Analyst, IT Risk Operations is a judgment-driven role responsible for reviewing, interpreting, and acting on risk signals produced by BMS's automated risk assessment infrastructure. As BMS transitions to a more automated operating model — where structured tiering, continuous monitoring, and integrated assessment frameworks handle intake and classification — the analyst's focus shifts decisively toward review, challenge, exception handling, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
This is not primarily a processing or intake role. It is an analytical and advisory role where sound risk judgment, clear communication, and accountability for final risk determinations are the core expectations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Risk Review & Judgment**

* Review and validate risk determinations produced through BMS's integrated risk assessment framework, including Cyber Tier assignments (Tiers 0–5), regulatory classifications (GDPR, EU AI Act, GxP, etc.), and control recommendations across 9 risk domains
* Apply independent analytical judgment to accept, challenge, or override system-generated risk outputs; document rationale clearly in ServiceNow (SNOW) for all override decisions
* Identify missing context, ambiguous scope, or inconsistencies between risk outputs and known project characteristics; engage project teams to resolve gaps before closing records
* Interpret and communicate risk signals and outputs in clear, stakeholder-facing language — translating technical determinations into actionable guidance without relying on raw tier scores or regulatory jargon

**Exception Handling & Escalation**

* Own exception handling for edge cases, novel technology types, cross-jurisdictional complexity, and cases where risk assessments indicate insufficient or ambiguous input
* Escalate material discrepancies to Risk Leads, BISOs, or Privacy SMEs with documented rationale; serve as the first line of analytical accountability for the risk record
* Support periodic review of auto-approved projects, identifying patterns or anomalies that warrant re-evaluation

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Lead or participate in structured touchpoints with project teams, informing them of assessment status, applicable controls, and required documentation
* Serve as a point of contact for project team questions about risk outputs; translate technical risk determinations into clear, actionable guidance
* Collaborate with Legal/Privacy SMEs (DPIA, TIA, SCC workflows) at defined handoff points to ensure risk findings are correctly consumed downstream

**Audit Readiness & Documentation**

* Maintain auditor-ready records in SNOW and GRC platforms; ensure every determination — accepted, challenged, or overridden — is traceable with documented rationale
* Prepare concise, high-quality assessment summaries and control attestations for management and compliance audiences
* Support internal and external audit activities by clearly articulating the basis for risk determinations and the human review actions that followed

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify patterns in override rates, exception types, and assessment flags that may indicate framework gaps or emerging risk themes
* Apply a continuous improvement mindset to enhance assessment quality, SLA performance, and the overall stakeholder experience

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in IT risk management, cybersecurity risk, IT audit, privacy compliance, or a directly related field
* Demonstrated ability to interpret and act on risk outputs or signals — not just execute process steps — with a clear track record of sound analytical judgment
* Working knowledge of NIST Cyber Risk Management Framework and NIST 800-53 controls library
* Familiarity with major data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, GxP)
* Experience with GRC platforms (ServiceNow GRC or equivalent)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain risk determinations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience with pre/post-implementation risk assessments, cybersecurity, data privacy, and/or digital transformation initiatives

**Preferred**

* Exposure to AI/ML risk assessment frameworks or emerging technology risk
* Experience working in automated or tool-assisted workflow environments
* Relevant certifications CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent

**Desired Candidate Characteristics**

* Strong analytical and risk judgment instincts — comfortable forming a defensible view from incomplete information
* Inquisitive and bold; willing to challenge outputs, ask difficult questions, and escalate when warranted
* Collaborative across IT, Legal, Privacy, and Business functions
* Comfortable working with system-generated risk signals and outputs rather than manually gathering inputs
* Adaptable to a continuously evolving, automation-enabled operating model with a growth mindset
* Commitment to healthcare and patient impact as the guiding north star for all risk decisions

**About the Role:**
Data Security Lead
  
  
**The Team:**
The IP Security team safeguards S&P Global’s proprietary assets—source code, models, datasets, design artifacts, architecture, and know‑how across applications and infrastructure. We set the standards, controls, and guardrails that prevent leakage, misuse, or unauthorized commercialization of intellectual property, and we enable product teams to innovate quickly while staying compliant with enterprise policy and regulatory obligations.
  
  
**Responsibilities and Impact:**
The Data Security Engineering Lead – Intellectual Property (IP) is accountable for designing, implementing, and operating S&P Global’s enterprise capabilities for protecting intellectual property. This role converts the IP security architecture into scalable, resilient engineering solutions that provide deep visibility into where critical data and IP artifacts reside, what type of data they represent, how they are accessed, and how they are utilized across applications and AI systems.
  
  
The Engineering Lead oversees the day‑to‑day technical execution of IP discovery, classification, access monitoring, and protection controls. The role includes leading a team of engineers and partnering closely with architecture, cloud, data, and AI platform teams to ensure comprehensive and consistent safeguarding of the company’s intellectual property.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
**Engineering & Platform Implementation**

* Lead the design, deployment, and operation of data security platforms supporting discovery, classification, and monitoring
* Implement enterprise-scale DSPM capabilities across cloud, on-prem, SaaS, and third-party environments
* Ensure platforms are reliable, scalable, and integrated with the broader security ecosystem

**Data Discovery & Classification Execution**

* Build and operate pipelines to identify where data resides across structured and unstructured sources
* Implement automated data classification and tagging aligned with enterprise standards
* Ensure continuous discovery and reclassification as data changes

**Data Sources & Access Monitoring**

* Integrate data security tools with IAM, cloud services, and data platforms
* Monitor and surface who has access to data, including privileged, service, and AI identities
* Detect over-permissioned access, stale entitlements, and anomalous data usage

**AI Data Consumption Controls**

* Implement controls to monitor and govern data used by AI agents, ML models, and training pipelines
* Instrument visibility into data flows supporting AI prompts, training, inference, and outputs
* Partner with AI platform teams to enforce approved data usage patterns

**Intellectual Property (IP) Protection Engineering**

* Implement IP protection mechanisms, including data watermarking, tagging, fingerprinting, and metadata controls
* Integrate IP protections into data pipelines and AI workflows
* Support detection and response to potential IP leakage events

**Operational Security & Incident Response**

* Operate and tune detection mechanisms for data exposure and misuse
* Support security incident investigations by rapidly identifying impacted data and access paths
* Partner with SOC and IR teams to automate alerts and response workflows

**Engineering Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data security engineers
* Establish engineering standards, coding practices, and operational runbooks
* Drive automation to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Partner with Data Security Architects, Cloud Security, IAM, Privacy, Legal, and AI teams
* Translate architectural requirements into deployable engineering solutions
* Provide technical input into roadmap planning and platform evaluations

**Basic Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in security engineering, data security, or platform security
* Strong hands-on experience implementing data discovery, classification, and monitoring solutions
* Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and data services
* Experience integrating security platforms with IAM, logging, SIEM, and SOAR
* Practical experience supporting AI/ML platforms and data pipelines
* Familiarity with IP protection techniques, including watermarking or tagging
* Strong scripting or programming skills (Python, Go, or similar)
* Experience operating production security platforms at scale

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with DSPM platforms (e.g., Cyera, Wiz DSPM, BigID)
* Background in regulated industries (financial services, data providers)
* Knowledge of DLP, CASB, encryption, and key management

title: Problem Manager
description:
**Immediate joiner only who can join on November 2**

**Job Description**

The IT Problem Manager is focused primarily on the functions within the Problem Management lifecycle, with additional effort on the metrics surrounding the Incident Management lifecycle. You will write detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports and present them to leadership and relevant stakeholders on a routine basis. You will work closely with Incident Managers within a Command Center to reduce the occurrence and duration of Major and Priority Incidents. You will facilitate meetings between Operations, Engineering, Development, and Client teams to construct a definitive narrative and timeline of an outage. You will need a strong understanding of solution and infrastructure architecture within multi-cloud and on-prem datacenter environments. Excellent written communication, verbal communication, conflict-resolution, interpersonal, presentation and customer service skills will be required.

**What you will do:**

* Review incidents that occurred and investigate why they took place, how they were resolved, how they can be prevented or mitigated in the future.
* Coordinate and moderate Post Incident Review meetings, as well as all follow up investigative communications
* Statistical analysis, tracking and communication of metrics associated with said incidents
* Investigate metrics to identify trends and highlight opportunities for improvements
* Establish strong partnerships with teams across Acxiom to ensure root causes are clearly explained, documented, and improvements are acted upon
* Demonstrate a sound understanding of functional/business objectives that drive and shape technology requirements
* Host a weekly Always On meeting with technical leadership to present Problem Management metrics
* Assign Problem Tasks or Corrective Actions following a Major Incident to address gaps

* Education: Bachelor’s degree
* 4-5 years of experience in Tech, Engineering or Software Development
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high volume, deadline-driven environment
* Attention to detail, and the ability to apply business intelligence/analytics through the Problem Management process
* Self-motivated to research complex technical issues with minimal oversight
* Clear understanding of ITIL processes, especially Incident and Problem Management
* ·Superb communication skills: seek understanding when investigating an incident and to track findings clearly in problem records

**What will set you apart:**

* Strong analytical/business intelligence experience
* Impeccable communication skills both written and verbal
* Passion for problem solving and investigative research
* Client Relationship experience

title: Delivery Consultant - Databases, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms & Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
  
  
You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof-of-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
  
  
Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  
Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  
  
Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  
  
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  
  
Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Elastic Engineer
description:
**Elastic Engineer — Job Description (Multiple Openings)**
Roles available
  
  
We are hiring for four roles across our Elastic Engineering and Elastic Operations teams. All candidates are assessed against one common set of requirements. Your experience and interview performance decide which role you are offered.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad. Operations roles are work-from-office on 24×7 rotational shifts.
  
  
Role Team Level Total experience Relevant Elastic experience Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Junior 2–4 yrs 2 yrs min Senior Elastic Engineer Elastic Engineering Senior (L2-capable) 8–12 yrs 4–6 yrs min Elastic Operations Engineer Elastic Operations L1 2–4 yrs 1–2 yrs min Elastic Operations Lead Elastic Operations L2 / Lead 6–10 yrs 3–4 yrs min
  
  
**About The Role**
You will build, run and scale Elastic/Observability platforms for a large enterprise SIEM programme. Our estate covers self-managed and self-hosted Elastic clusters on AWS (EC2 and EKS) and Azure, ingesting security and observability data at enterprise scale.
  
  

* Elastic Engineering designs, automates, onboards data and upgrades the platform.
* Elastic Operations keeps it healthy and stable around the clock, handles tickets and incidents, and drives RCAs.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Scope and depth grow with level. Junior and L1 roles execute; Senior and Lead roles design, own and lead.
  
  
Platform engineering
  
  

* Install, configure, size and maintain ELK clusters (self-managed and self-hosted): node roles, data tiers, ILM, snapshots, CCR/CCS
* Deploy and operate Elastic on EKS (ECK or Helm)
* Plan and execute cluster upgrades, from manual rolling upgrades to fully automated upgrades with pre-checks and rollback
* Onboard data sources through Fleet, Elastic Agent and integrations, Beats, Logstash and OpenTelemetry
* Build Logstash pipelines and ingest pipelines for parsing, enrichment and ECS normalisation
* Set up APM and OpenTelemetry agents and collectors
* Configure anomaly detection jobs, Kibana spaces, RBAC and role mappings
* Build dashboards in Kibana and Grafana

Automation and cloud
  
  

* Automate platform tasks in Python against Elasticsearch and Kibana APIs
* Build CI/CD pipelines and manage infrastructure with Terraform
* Design AWS log collection and connectivity: VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect

Operations and support
  
  

* Monitor cluster health, ingestion and capacity; perform routine maintenance
* Handle tickets within SLA; triage and resolve issues at L1, escalate or resolve at L2
* Join and lead incident bridges, including Sev1 calls; manage escalations
* Write RCAs and runbooks; track corrective actions to closure
* Senior and Lead roles: mentor engineers, review designs and code, manage shift rosters and report operational KPIs

Requirements in detail
  
  
Candidates should cover most of the areas below. The depth expected rises with the role.
  
  
Elastic Stack core
  
  

* ELK setup and administration on self-managed and self-hosted clusters
* Cluster troubleshooting: unassigned shards, heap and disk pressure, circuit breakers, slow queries, node failures and recovery
* Elasticsearch APIs (\_cat, \_cluster, \_nodes, index and ILM APIs, Query DSL) and Kibana APIs
* KQL, with working knowledge of ES|QL
* Index design, mappings, templates, ILM and data tiers (hot, warm, cold, frozen)
* Cluster upgrades: planning, pre-checks, rolling upgrade, validation and rollback

Data onboarding and parsing
  
  

* Fleet, Elastic Agent and its integrations
* Logstash: pipeline configuration, filters, persistent queues and tuning
* Ingest pipelines and data parsing (grok, dissect, processors, ECS mapping)

Observability
  
  

* APM setup and configuration
* OpenTelemetry agent and collector setup
* Dashboarding in Kibana and Grafana
* Anomaly detection (machine learning) jobs

Access and security
  
  

* Kibana spaces, RBAC, roles and role mapping (SAML, LDAP, AD)
* TLS and certificate management for the stack

Cloud, containers and networking
  
  

* AWS basics (EC2, S3, IAM, EKS) and Azure basics
* VPC concepts: subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs
* Network connectivity options: VPC peering, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect, load balancers
* EKS and Kubernetes operations, including ECK
* Senior level: AWS architecture in depth, including VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail and cross-account logging

Automation and DevOps (Senior Engineer and Operations Lead)
  
  

* Hands-on Python for automation against Elastic APIs
* CI/CD setup (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar)
* Terraform and infrastructure as code; Git-based workflows
* A track record of automations delivered, e.g. upgrade automation, onboarding automation, health-check scripts

Operations practice (Operations roles; valued for all)
  
  

* Ticket handling within SLA in ServiceNow, Jira or similar
* Incident calls, Sev1 triage and escalation handling
* RCA findings and write-ups; runbook and knowledge-base upkeep
* ITIL incident, problem and change processes
* Willingness to work 24×7 rotational shifts from office

Good to have
  
  

* Elastic Certified Engineer or Elastic Certified Observability Engineer
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional); HashiCorp Terraform Associate; ITIL v4 Foundation
* Exposure to Elastic Security (SIEM) and detection rules
* Azure log sources and networking (Event Hub, Azure Monitor)
* Linux administration and shell scripting

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field
* Clear written and spoken communication for tickets, RCAs and stakeholder updates

* Design and optimize passwordless, MFA, and phishing-resistant authentication strategies.
* Define standards for legacy protocol containment and deprecation.

* Drive Infrastructure-as-Code for identity (Terraform/Bicep/Graph automation).

* Review designs, mentor senior engineers, and raise overall technical bar.
* Influence roadmap decisions and long-term identity strategy.

* 15+ years in IAM with deep Microsoft Entra ID & Active Directory expertise
* Proven experience architecting large-scale hybrid identity platforms
* Deep expertise in:

+ Conditional Access & Identity Protection
+ MFA & Passwordless Authentication
+ Federation (SAML, OIDC, OAuth)
+ Privileged Access Models

* Strong automation and engineering mindset
* Ability to operate at both whiteboard and code level

* Clear architectural patterns adopted enterprise-wide
* Reduced dependency on vendor “defaults” through engineering control

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cloud Security Architecture & Design Controls
* Design and implement secure, scalable, and resilient AWS cloud architectures aligned with enterprise security standards and best practices.
* Define security controls for AWS environments, including account structures, landing zones, workload isolation, and security boundaries.
* Design and implement network segmentation using VPCs, subnets, security groups, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, and other cloud-native security controls.
* Establish appropriate security controls for internet-facing, internal, and highly sensitive workloads.
* Design secure connectivity between AWS, on-premises data centers, and third-party environments.
* Implement encryption for data at rest and in transit using services and technologies such as AWS KMS, TLS/SSL, and certificate management.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for new cloud workloads, migrations, application modernization, and cloud transformation initiatives.
* Identify security risks in proposed architectures and provide practical recommendations to mitigate those risks.
* Develop and maintain cloud security reference architectures, security patterns, standards, and design guidelines.
* Ensure security controls are consistently applied across development, testing, and production environments.
* Identity & Access Management (IAM)
* Design and maintain robust Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls based on the principles of least privilege and zero trust.
* Define and manage IAM roles, policies, permission boundaries, service roles, and cross-account access.
* Implement and enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and strong authentication mechanisms.
* Establish appropriate access controls for employees, administrators, applications, workloads, and third-party users.
* Implement secure privileged-access mechanisms for administrative and high-risk accounts.
* Integrate AWS environments with enterprise Identity Providers and Single Sign-On (SSO) platforms.
* Regularly review IAM permissions to identify excessive, unused, or inappropriate access.
* Identify and remediate risks such as overly permissive IAM policies, exposed credentials, inactive accounts, and inappropriate privilege escalation paths.
* Establish processes for joiner, mover, and leaver access management.
* Support periodic access reviews and provide evidence for security and compliance audits.
* Security Automation & DevSecOps
* Integrate security controls and automated security checks into CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement security testing across infrastructure, application, container, and cloud configurations.
* Use Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform to consistently deploy and manage cloud security controls.
* Implement automated checks for infrastructure misconfigurations, insecure configurations, and policy violations before deployment.
* Introduce policy-as-code and automated compliance validation where appropriate.
* Automate remediation of common cloud security misconfigurations and security findings.
* Work closely with DevOps and engineering teams to embed DevSecOps practices into the software development lifecycle.
* Develop reusable Terraform modules, security templates, policies, and automation frameworks.
* Ensure security controls are repeatable, auditable, version-controlled, and integrated into automated deployment processes.
* Continuously improve the organization's security posture through automation and standardization.

Key Attributes
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate security requirements into practical cloud architectures and technical controls.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work across architecture, engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, and security teams.
* Strong ownership of security risks and remediation.
* Ability to balance security, business requirements, operational considerations, and delivery timelines.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a Consultant– AI/ML/DevSecOps / Application Security with strong hands-on delivery experience in SAST, SCA, and DAST to embed security across the software development lifecycle. This role focuses on implementing and operating application security tooling in CI/CD pipelines, executing application security assessments (including API security), triaging and prioritizing findings, enabling remediation, and driving secure-by-design engineering practices across cloud-native and enterprise applications. SAST, SCA, and DAST remain foundational AppSec capabilities, and the role is positioned accordingly with an emphasis on measurable delivery outcomes (tool onboarding, pipeline coverage, risk reduction, and remediation closure).
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Integrate, configure, and optimize static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and dynamic application security testing (DAST) tools in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, including quality gates and exception workflows.
* Perform security assessments across application code, open-source dependencies, REST and GraphQL application programming interfaces (APIs), cloud-native workloads, containers, and Kubernetes environments to identify vulnerabilities, exposed secrets, configuration gaps, and software supply-chain risks.
* Triage scan results, validate findings, prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability and business impact, and provide remediation guidance, compensating controls, and verification steps.
* Facilitate threat modeling and security design reviews; translate risks into secure design requirements, test cases, acceptance criteria, and engineering backlog items.
* Implement DevSecOps controls, including infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, container image scanning, policy-as-code, software bills of materials, and build and release integrity controls.
* Design and build artificial intelligence agents and agentic workflows for application security automation; assess AI/ML and generative AI application risks; and deliver client reports, dashboards, trend analysis, and implementation roadmaps.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance

**Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata**
**Shift Timings: Rotational**

Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or another technical discipline.
* 3-6 years of hands-on application security or DevSecOps experience, including operation of SAST, SCA, and DAST capabilities in CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with at least one application security tool: Checkmarx, Veracode, Fortify, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, Mend/WhiteSource, or Black Duck.
* Experience integrating security controls into Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps, including pipeline templates, quality gates, and exception workflows; experience using Python or Bash for application security automation.
* Experience performing REST or GraphQL API security testing, including authentication and authorization testing, input validation, rate limiting, broken object-level authorization, and broken function-level authorization; experience with vulnerability triage and remediation validation.
* Experience conducting threat modeling and security architecture reviews for modern applications, microservices, or APIs.
* Experience designing and building AI agents or agentic workflows for security or engineering use cases, including tool or function calling, multi-step orchestration, logging, guardrails, and human validation.

* Experience applying the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard to define or validate application security requirements.
* Experience implementing container or Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, or policy-as-code controls.
* Experience implementing software or AI/ML supply-chain controls, including software bills of materials, model bills of materials, artifact signing or verification, dependency pinning, build provenance, model registries, or data and model lineage.
* Experience applying artificial intelligence security guidance, including OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, MITRE ATLAS, National Institute of Standards and Technology AI Risk Management Framework, or Google Secure AI Framework.
* Experience implementing large language model guardrails, safety controls, or agent sandboxing patterns.
* Certification in DevSecOps, cloud security, Kubernetes security, AI security, or generative AI, such as Certified Cloud Security Professional, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, or AWS Certified AI Practitioner.

title: Architect I - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role Description**
Cloud Architect, Codon Platform (AWS and Azure)
  
  
Location: UST Hyderabad
  
  
Type: Full time, in-house
  
  
**About The Role**
Codon is UST's governed developer platform: a web chat and a browser terminal that put Claude to work on ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms, with every write
  
  
audited, every secret brokered, and every destination controlled at the network edge. It runs today on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, EFS, internal ALB with blue/green
  
  
deployments, a Squid egress tier) with Azure for identity (Entra) and Key Vault, reached over a transit gateway, SD-WAN and Zscaler.
  
  
We are hiring the person who owns this architecture end to end and takes it from a single-tenant dev and pilot footprint to a secure, multi-tenant, resilient product. You
  
  
will be the technical authority for infrastructure, the counterpart to our network, security, identity and AI gateway teams, and the hands that write the Terraform.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Architecture and roadmap
  
  

* Own the target architecture for Codon across AWS and Azure: landing zone, account and subscription structure, network, identity, data, secrets, observability.
* Design and deliver multi-tenancy: tenant isolation at the account, network, data and identity layers; per-tenant cost attribution; tenant onboarding as code.
* Design and deliver disaster recovery and business continuity: RPO and RTO targets per tier, cross-region strategy, backup and restore drills, runbooks that are

rehearsed, not written once.
  
  

* Define the environment model (dev, test, pilot, production) and the promotion path between them, including the deployment gate that holds a release until its checks

Security
  
  

* Raise the platform to a documented security posture: least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secret rotation with zero downtime (we already rotate database and gateway

keys), private endpoints, egress allow-listing, encryption and key management (KMS and Key Vault).
  
  

* Run threat modelling for the platform's trust boundaries, including an AI agent with a shell inside a container, and close the findings.
* Prepare the platform for internal security review and for customer audits (SOC 2 style evidence, logging and retention, access reviews).

Build and operate
  
  

* Write and review the Terraform (modules, environment roots, policy as code). Everything is code; nothing is clicked in a console.
* Own the CI/CD and release tooling with the product team: image builds, SBOMs, the deployer, evidence capture.
* Set up observability that answers questions in minutes: central logging, metrics, tracing, ing, cost dashboards.
* Lead incident analysis across teams. Recent examples from our own log: a rotated database password that silently broke new connections, an egress path that drops for

hours on a shared security gateway, a load balancer whose private addresses changed under a fixed route.
  
  
Work with others
  
  

* Be the single technical contact for UST's Network, Cloud, Security, Identity and AI gateway teams; turn their constraints into designs and their requests into tickets

with evidence.
  
  

* Pair with the product engineers daily. Review their infrastructure changes, teach them the platform's rules, and keep the design records current.
* Guide one or two platform engineers as the team grows.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* 12 to 14 years in software or infrastructure engineering, of which at least 10 years hands-on in public cloud, with production ownership on both AWS and Azure. Depth on

one, real delivery on the other.
  
  

* You have designed and operated at least one multi-tenant SaaS platform and at least one cross-region DR setup, and you can describe what broke in each.
* You have written Terraform for years, not months. You can read a plan and tell what will be replaced and why.

Technical
  
  

* AWS: VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, ECS or EKS, RDS, EFS, ALB and NLB, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, Route 53, Organizations and SCPs.
* Azure: Entra ID (enterprise apps, SAML and OIDC, conditional access), Key Vault with private endpoints, VNets and Private Link, Azure Policy, hybrid connectivity.
* Networking: routing across cloud and on-premises, SD-WAN and security gateways such as Zscaler, TLS and certificate lifecycle, DNS split-horizon.
* Security: zero trust principles, workload identity, secret rotation, container hardening, audit logging, compliance evidence.
* Containers and delivery: Docker, Fargate or Kubernetes, blue/green and canary deployments, GitHub Actions or equivalent, SBOM and vulnerability management.
* Comfortable reading application code (TypeScript or Python) well enough to find where an infrastructure assumption lives.

Ways of working
  
  

* You write things down: decision records, runbooks, incident reports with evidence. You prefer a diagram and a table to a meeting.
* You test in production-like conditions and rehearse failures before they happen.
* You are direct with other teams about what is theirs and what is ours, with the logs to show it.

Certifications (any two, or equivalent demonstrated experience)
  
  

* AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional
* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* A security credential such as AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or CCSP

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience hosting LLM or agent workloads: gateways, key brokering, cost metering per user, isolation of agent sandboxes.
* Enterprise platform background: ServiceNow, Salesforce or SAP integration patterns.
* FinOps practice: cost allocation by tenant, rightsizing, commitment planning.
* Exposure to regulated environments and customer audits.

First six months, what success looks like
  
  

* A written target architecture for multi-tenant Codon on AWS and Azure, reviewed with Security and Network, with a sequenced plan.
* Production environment stood up as code with the deployment gate, logging, ing and cost reporting in place.
* A DR design with targets agreed, and the first restore drill completed and documented.
* The current security findings closed, secret rotation proven without downtime, and an audit evidence pack that a reviewer can read.
* Standing working agreements with the Network, Identity and AI gateway teams, with named contacts and response expectations.

**Skills**
AWS, Azure Policy, AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Fargate

title: CyberSecurity Specialist - VM
description:
**#Cyber Security Experts#**
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role focuses on protecting enterprise systems through expert vulnerability management thorough vulnerability assessment and effective identity access control while leveraging cyber threat intelligence services. The CyberSecurity Specialist for threat and vulnerability management applies five to eight years of experience to safeguard critical assets support business continuity and enable secure digital growth across sales and marketing platforms in a day shift environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze complex system landscapes and applications to identify vulnerabilities and misconfigurations ensuring timely remediation that reduces exposure across enterprise environments and supports secure hybrid operations.
* Coordinate end to end vulnerability management cycles from discovery and prioritization to remediation verification using industry standard tools and methods to improve overall risk posture and strengthen organizational resilience.
* Apply structured vulnerability assessment techniques to evaluate servers endpoints networks and applications producing clear and actionable reports that guide technical teams and stakeholders toward focused risk reduction.
* Utilize cyber threat intelligence services to correlate emerging threat indicators with known vulnerabilities enabling proactive defense measures and helping the organization anticipate hostile activity before it impacts critical services.
* Implement and optimize identity and access management controls including provisioning deprovisioning and access review workflows that maintain strict access hygiene and support compliance requirements across business units.
* Collaborate with application owners and infrastructure teams to validate risk ratings for identified issues recommend remediation options aligned with business priorities and drive closure of high impact findings within agreed timelines.
* Monitor security dashboards and vulnerability feeds during day shifts to detect anomalies related to privileged access exploited weaknesses or new threat campaigns and promptly escalate significant events according to defined processes.
* Document technical procedures security baselines and operational runbooks for threat and vulnerability management ensuring repeatable practices and enabling consistent security operations across hybrid work arrangements.
* Engage with stakeholders from sales and marketing domains to understand key digital journeys and campaign platforms integrating cybersecurity controls that protect customer data while enabling effective and secure business outreach.
* Support audit and compliance activities by providing evidence of vulnerability scans remediation tracking and identity control enforcement contributing to successful assessments and reinforcing trust with clients and partners.
* Recommend security technology improvements and process refinements based on analysis of vulnerability trends and threat intelligence outputs helping the company continuously evolve its defenses and reduce long term risk.
* Provide guidance to peers on secure configuration practices and safe use of digital tools promoting a culture of cybersecurity awareness that benefits the wider society through more robust protection of personal and business information.
* Participate in incident handling related to exploitation of vulnerabilities or misuse of identities by supplying root cause insights and corrective actions that prevent recurrence and enhance future detection capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate five to eight years of dedicated experience in cyber security with a strong focus on threat and vulnerability management in enterprise scale environments and familiarity with hybrid work models.
* Possess advanced experience in identity and access management including policy design lifecycle management and periodic access reviews that ensure only appropriate and justified access to systems and data.
* Show hands on expertise with cyber threat intelligence services including consumption of threat feeds indicator analysis and integration of intelligence into vulnerability and risk management workflows.
* Bring substantial practical background in vulnerability management and vulnerability assessment using recognized platforms and scanners while translating technical findings into clear remedial actions for engineering teams.
* Exhibit an understanding of sales and marketing domain processes and digital tools that enables alignment of security controls with customer engagement activities and supports secure delivery of campaigns and analytics.
* Communicate clearly in written and verbal form with cross functional teams conveying complex security topics in accessible language and collaborating effectively without the need for travel.

title: Sr. Security Operations Analyst
description:
**Job Description IAM Operations Analyst / Engineer Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Operations Analyst to support day-to-day IAM operations across enterprise applications and identity platforms. The role is responsible for user access provisioning and deprovisioning, application access management, Active Directory (AD) and Microsoft Entra ID administration, group management, and ensuring adherence to security, compliance, and operational standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Application Access Management**

* Process application access requests, modifications, and removals in accordance with approved procedures.
* Perform user provisioning and deprovisioning across enterprise applications.
* Validate approvals and ensure appropriate authorization before granting access.
* Support role-based access control (RBAC) and entitlement management activities.
* Investigate and resolve access-related incidents and service requests.
* Maintain accurate records of user access and access changes.

**Identity Lifecycle Management**

* Execute Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
* Ensure timely onboarding and offboarding of workforce members.
* Support automated and manual provisioning workflows.
* Monitor provisioning failures and perform corrective actions.
* Coordinate with application owners and HR teams to maintain access accuracy.

**Active Directory Administration**

* Manage user, group, and service accounts within Active Directory.
* Create, modify, and remove security groups and distribution groups.
* Perform password resets, account unlocks, and user account maintenance.
* Support Group Policy administrative activities as required.
* Troubleshoot AD operational issues and escalate complex incidents.

**Microsoft Entra ID Administration**

* Manage users, groups, licenses, and administrative roles in Microsoft Entra ID.
* Support identity synchronization and hybrid identity operations.
* Perform Entra ID group creation, modification, and membership management.
* Support MFA, Conditional Access, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM) operational activities.
* Monitor and resolve Entra ID-related incidents and service requests.

**Compliance and Governance**

* Participate in periodic access reviews and certification campaigns.
* Support audit evidence collection and compliance activities.
* Ensure adherence to security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, and knowledge articles.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and automation use cases.

**Required Qualifications**
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.
* 3-6 years of experience in IAM Operations, Identity Administration, or Access Management.
* Hands-on experience with:

+ Active Directory
+ Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
+ User and group administration
+ Identity lifecycle management (JML)
+ Access provisioning and deprovisioning
+ ServiceNow or similar ticketing platforms

* Strong understanding of RBAC and access governance concepts.
* Experience working within defined SLAs and operational support environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SailPoint, One Identity, Saviynt, or similar IGA solutions.
* Experience supporting PAM platforms such as CyberArk or BeyondTrust.
* Knowledge of MFA, Conditional Access, and PIM.
* Understanding of SOX, HIPAA, ISO 27001, or other compliance frameworks.
* Scripting experience using PowerShell for IAM automation.

**Key Skills**

* Identity & Access Management
* Active Directory Administration
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Application Access Management
* User Provisioning & Deprovisioning
* Group Management
* RBAC Administration
* Access Governance
* ServiceNow
* PowerShell
* Incident & Request Management
* Audit & Compliance Support

**Success Measures**

* Access requests fulfilled within SLA.
* Timely completion of provisioning and deprovisioning activities.
* Zero unauthorized access incidents due to operational errors.
* Successful completion of access reviews and audit requirements.
* High customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

description:
**Job Requirements**
**Job Description**
We're looking for a full-time phenomenal Application Security Engineer I to identify and assist in the mitigation of application vulnerabilities discovered in the Phenom ITX platform. This includes prioritization of vulnerabilities according to the threat vectors and attack techniques, the orchestration of remediation plans and the vulnerability remediation progress tracking via reports and dashboards.
  
  
Additionally, the Application Security Analyst will participate in the continuous improvement and innovation of Phenom’s vulnerability management program and help on the deployment of Phenom Secure Architecture & Software Development program.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Research, identify and analyze and triage vulnerabilities that could affect Phenom ITX Platform and its supporting infrastructure, and determine its severity, exploitability and corrective action recommendations, summarizing and reporting results.
* Collaborate with engineering/development teams to evolve software assurance processes to address security risks, and help teams learn and adopt shift-security-to-left practices.
* Work on implementing the required fixes to remediate the vulnerabilities in collaboration with the engineering team
* Deploy, improve and utilize SAST/DAST/SCA and other cybersecurity solutions to identify and communicate security vulnerabilities to Phenom production teams
* Maintain and report progress on the state of application vulnerabilities and escalate as necessary to ensure vulnerability issues are closed and handled in a manner consistent with Phenom standards
* Work closely with the business, support and production teams to provide input and guidance on development of planned remediation plans and strategies to solve identified vulnerabilities
* Use technical writing and effective communications to prepare and deliver vulnerability assessment result reports to all levels of audiences (peers and or leadership).
* Drive compliance support and improvements over time through the management, analysis and tracking of vulnerabilities discovered through audits, products or collaborations.
* Perform research and analytics and stay apprised on new security vulnerability, threats, risks, attack tools and techniques to contribute and improve Phenom’s Threat model and collaborate with senior engineering and product management staff to incorporate effective security standards and controls into product design.
* Help in the deployment of Phenom Secure Architecture & Software Development program to support the best cybersecurity development practice, and ensure Phenom ITX Platform is highly secure, resilient and aligned with business and product development strategy.
* Continuously review and identify security improvement opportunities in existing processes, services, and workflows to ensure Phenom ITX platform is robust against current and future cybersecurity threats.
* Support cybersecurity process activities including security requirements definition, threat modelling, code reviews and cyber risk assessment.
* Support on development and maintenance of a “security by default” standard to be used in the development, infrastructure, or any other technology project.
* Deliver training on Security Development Lifecycle to engineering/development teams
* Contribute to the review of internal processes and activities and assist in identifying potential opportunities for improvement and automation.
* Drive continuous improvement activities to define, measure, visualize and improve key cyber security metrics related to Application Security.
* Provide analytic support to answer questions about vulnerabilities, and general threat intelligence trends

**Must Have**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in related field
* 3+ years of hands-on technical expertise as Application Security Engineer

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Experience with Amazon Web Services cloud environments and its security controls and their corresponding challenges.
* Experience with microservices architectures & distributed Platforms especially in the SaaS businesses
* Experience using Agile software development
* Coding Experience in Scripting & programming languages (such as Terraform, Java, Python, Ruby, etc.)
* Knowledge of information security principles (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability Authentication & Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Data Security or Cryptography), and understanding of common exploitation techniques and mitigation.
* Experience implementing, managing, and supporting a vulnerability management program (process and technology).
* Experience and well-known understanding of Dynamic and Static Application Security Testing (DAST & SAST) and infrastructure automation/development utilizing APIs.
* Understanding of the main cybersecurity tools (SIEM, IPS, XDR, etc.) and how they help to protect an application.
* Experience working with Threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA, FAIR, Security Cards) and vulnerability frameworks standards (e.g., OWASP, CVSS, CWE) with a good understanding of the Cyber Kill Chain and pervasive threat attack methods and remediation.
* Critical thinking, strong organizational skills, report writing skills to senior level, ability to prioritize and multitask
* Familiarity with using AI-assisted tools

title: Security Architect II
description:
**Details:**
As a Security Architect and Engineer, you will lead the charge in fortifying our organization's security infrastructure. Your role encompasses designing and implementing robust security solutions tailored to our unique needs, ensuring that our systems, data, and networks remain resilient against potential threats. Collaborating closely with various stakeholders, you'll assess existing security frameworks, implement effective measures, and uphold stringent standards.
  
  
The individual will be a key member of the Architecture Review Board (ARB), helping ensure significant technology initiatives are evaluated for security, architecture, integration, operational impact, risk, and long-term supportability.
  
  
Your responsibilities extend beyond design, encompassing practical implementation and integration of security solutions into our existing infrastructure. You'll configure and deploy tools such as privileged identity management, secure cloud posture management, and secure application development technologies, AI controls, ensuring seamless integration while upholding rigorous security protocols.
  
  
****Architectural Security Design:****

* Develop and maintain architectural security standards, guidelines, and best practices.
* Design secure, scalable, and resilient security architectures for various systems and applications.
* Identify, quantify, and provide design remediations for security risks as they relate to enterprise projects.
* Evaluate existing systems and propose enhancements to improve security posture.
* Partner with business members and IT leaders to drive security strategy and direction
* Produce management reporting, including appropriate metrics that inform senior leadership as to the state of information security risk and exposure
* Understands security product / service cost drivers and industry and business trends impacting the client information security program
* Provide information security matter expertise to technology teams and projects
* Ensure that the organization is leveraging the proper technologies to meet security related policies (including FTC, PCI)
* Ensure compliance with local regulations e.g. local encryption regulations and privacy law

**Architecture Review Board**

* Serve as a key technical member of the Architecture Review Board (ARB).
* Review significant technology initiatives and proposed architectural changes.
* Identify security concerns, dependencies, architectural impacts, operational considerations, and technical risks before implementation.
* Help teams evaluate alternative approaches and document architecture decisions.
* Improve the quality and consistency of technical information presented to the ARB.
* Help determine which initiatives require deeper security and architecture review. This aligns with prior internal discussion that Security should help evaluate projects against agreed standards and determine which should proceed through architecture review.

****Security Solution Implementation:****

* Implement security solutions based on industry standards and organizational requirements.
* Configure and deploy security tools, such as cloud security governance and monitoring, firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, endpoint protection, and encryption mechanisms.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security measures into new and existing systems.
* Recognizes and identifies potential areas where existing technical security polices standards and procedures require change, or where new ones need to be developed, especially regarding future business expansion
* Evaluate and recommend security software/hardware and its integration into existing architecture (Proof of Technology)

Job Requirements
  
  
**Details:**

* 10+ years equivalent work experience
* 3+ years experience as a security architect or consultant with enterprise experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaboration skills, and the ability to communicate security and risk-related concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* In depth knowledge of information security practices related to PCI, SOX, FTC, and OWASP application security.
* Exhibit excellent analytical skills, the ability to manage multiple projects under strict timelines, as well as the ability to work well in a demanding, dynamic environment and meet overall objectives.
* Professional security management certification, such as a Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), AWS or Azure Certifications as related to security and architecture, Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) or other similar credentials, is preferred.
* Knowledge of common information security management frameworks, such as ISO/IEC 27001, ITIL, COBIT and ones from NIST and CIS are preferred.

****Technical Knowledge Areas:****

* Security Architecture Design : Ability to design secure, scalable, and resilient security architectures for various systems and applications including AI.
* Security Technologies : Proficiency in security tools and technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), SIEM, endpoint protection, encryption mechanisms, etc.
* Network Security : Understanding of network security principles, protocols, and technologies (e.g., VPN, SSL/TLS, IPsec, DNSSEC, SASE) inclusive of Zero Trust architecture
* Cloud Security : Knowledge of cloud security principles and experience with securing cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including identity and access management (IAM), data encryption, and secure configuration.
* Application Security : Familiarity with secure coding practices, web application firewalls (WAF), secure development life cycle (SDLC), and vulnerability assessment tools.
* Operating Systems : Proficiency in securing various operating systems, including Windows, Linux, and Unix.
* Encryption : Understanding of cryptographic principles and protocols, such as symmetric/asymmetric encryption, digital signatures, SSL/TLS, and PKI.
* Compliance : Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS) and experience in ensuring compliance with security regulations.
* Data Governance : Data Loss Prevention, File Integrity Monitoring, SEIM, Data scanning and tagging, Microsoft AIP

* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.

title: USI | FY27 | Audit Services | SAP GITC - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior Consultant, Technology Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance**
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte’s clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
  
  
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Senior consultant, you will build and nurture positive working relationships with Deloitte teams who work with clients with the intention to exceed client expectations. You will:
  
  

* Identify and evaluate complex business/ technological risks, internal controls which mitigate risks, and related opportunities for internal control improvement
* Perform system evaluation and/or audit IT and business process as a part of SOX 404, SSAE 18 or ICFR assessment in accordance with PCAOB/AICPA guidance using Deloitte methodology for whole point
* Perform complete GITC evaluation and testing across IT platform including, operating systems, databases, and network components
* Perform risk assessment for organizations to identify prioritized list of risk/audit
* Perform controls benchmarking to leading internal controls framework to identify gaps and excess controls
* Manage multiple assignments and demonstrate strong people management & networking skills
* Ensure timely completion of activities with quality, complete ownership of deliverables and early escalations to management, if required
* Play substantive/lead role on projects including project planning, economics, and managing quality
* Participate in proposal development efforts
* Assist in technical knowledge development and training efforts
* Demonstrate high level of understanding of internal and external client's business

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree
* MBA in Finance/Accounting /IT/Information security and or CA/CPA/CIA/CISA/CISSP

**Required Skills**

* 4-8 years of relevant work experience, with industry focus a plus
* Strong orientation toward internal control risk assessment, operational, and IT auditing
* Hands on experience on testing of SAP GITC controls(Change Management, Access Security, UAR) Test of design(TOD) and test of operating effectiveness (TOE)
* Have tested SAP Automated controls (3 way match, duplicate invoices, copy controls etc) across SAP ECC, S/4 HANA
* Experience of assessing and reviewing technology risks and controls over areas including access management, change management & computer operations for IT platforms (operating systems, databases, and network components)
* Exposure to any one industry—Financial Services; Technology, Media & Telecom; Life Sciences & Health Care; Energy & Resources; Consumer & Industrial Products
* Demonstrate MS office proficiency, problem solving & analytical skills, and strong verbal & written communication skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments, manage ambiguity, and work independently or as part of a team with professionals at all levels

**Preferred Skills**

* Big Four experience preferred
* Hands-on experience/understanding of security (SAP ECC, S/4 HANA, GRC AC and PC, SAP B/W) and functioning of ERP (At least one of – SAP or Oracle EBS or JDE or Peoplesoft or Netsuite or Workday or SAP Ariba)
* Understanding of SAP Cloud will be added advantage

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
