title: Senior Structured Data Access Control Process Analyst
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
*all*
.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
The
**Senior Structured Data Access Control Process Analyst**
will play an important role in supporting Micron's Structured Data Access Control (sDAC) program and related data governance initiatives. This role analyzes business processes, identifies opportunities for automation and efficiency, develops reporting and dashboard solutions, supports operational workloads, and contributes to projects that strengthen secure and compliant access to enterprise structured data.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong analytical thinking with process improvement, stakeholder engagement, reporting, and project execution skills. Working closely with technical and business teams, they will transform complex governance processes into actionable insights and help drive continuous improvements across access management and governance workflows.
  
  
This position supports both day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives, helping advance governance modernization, workflow automation, and user experience improvements across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Structured Data Access Control (SDAC) process and related governance workflows along with the knowledge of Role Based Access Control (RBAC) and data security management for integration.
* Define, document and improve business processes, requirements, workflows, operating procedures, governance standards, user guidance, training material and communications.
* Identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, and efficiency improvements.
* Leveraging AI powered tools and other technologies to improve analysis, research, and productivity.
* Serve as a project contributor, feature owner, or workstream lead for governance initiatives. Includes tracking and communicating project status, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions to understand business needs, gather requirements, and address process challenges.
* Facilitate partnerships with developers to define business requirements and acceptance criteria. Participate in requirements gathering, planning, testing, deployment, change management, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validation activities.
* Collaborate with BISOs, architects, DBAs, developers, governance teams, and business stakeholders.
* Support user adoption efforts and partner with governance and security teams on RBAC-related initiatives.
* Perform deep data analysis to detect patterns and drive to results. Along with developing data-driven recommendations to improve service quality, cycle time, operational effectiveness, and user experience. Monitor service levels and operational health.
* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI, ServiceNow, and governance reporting solutions, dashboards, and operational metrics.
* Analyze trends, bottlenecks, Service Level Agreement (SLA) performance, and operational health metrics to provide actionable insights, create executive-ready reporting and present to leadership and stakeholder on governance recommendation.
* Support operational ticket queues, governance workflows, and triage and resolution of access request review along with assisting users and stakeholders with governance-related inquiries.
* Support audit, certification, and compliance activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Information Systems, Business Data Analytics, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of work experience in business analysis, governance, operations, analytics, or process improvement.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, developing reports, dashboards, and metrics using Power BI, ServiceNow and the Microsoft 365 suites.
* Self-motivated, organized, and highly capable of carrying out detailed plans with limited direction.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative and inclusive with a positive attitude, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams across geographical and organizational cultures and to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting data governance, access management, and IAM governance programs, with familiarity in RBAC concepts.
* Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) or Oracle Database role and direct access permissions.
* Knowledge of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies. PMP, Scrum, Agile, or Business Analysis certifications are a plus.
* Experience with ServiceNow workflow design and automation, Microsoft 365 collaboration tools (SharePoint, Planner, Power Automate), and Power BI data modeling and advanced visualization techniques.

title: Cyber Threat Management Analyst, Specialist- Secure AI Enablement ESF
description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Cyber Threat Management Analyst, Specialist role provides expert level technical support for cyber threats and threat attack methodologies. Collects and analyzes system data to identify, contain, mitigate, and recover from cyber security threats or incidents. Conducts research and gathers information from global threat intelligence sources, pertaining to emerging cyber threats and threat attack methodologies. Additionally, the role involves designing and testing secure systems to protect sensitive information, managing virus protection and intrusion detection systems, performing comprehensive risk audits, and implementing disaster recovery strategies to ensure business continuity during security incidents.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Leads and responds to escalated cyber security alerts, cyber incidents, or related security investigations. Identifies real-time complex attack patterns and suggests mitigation strategies.
* Leads the processes, tools and measures to monitor and detect compromises, risks, vulnerabilities, network security threats, tools and tactics used by modern and emerging threat actors. Facilitates security operations and incident response technologies and methodologies.
* Develops, manages, maintains and enhances security controls (alerts, rules, policies, and signatures) for the security platforms.
* Reviews the network environment for new and evolving cyber threats and provides preventive and remedial solutions. Identifies malicious activity by performing analysis on logs, traffic flows, and other investigative detective activities.
* Conducts penetration testing, vulnerability assessments and threat modeling. Evaluates risks and makes recommendations.
* Provides written assessments focused on threats, vulnerabilities, and technologies relevant to Vanguard Infrastructure.
* Leads with IT and business teams to ensure prompt and effective distribution of findings so incidents are effectively addressed. Provides department support to the business on enterprise-wide security initiatives and projects.
* Mentors junior team members to improve their technical acumen.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Designs and tests secure operating systems, networks, and databases to safeguard infrastructure and protect sensitive information.
* Conducts password audits and manages virus protection, ensuring strong intrusion detection systems are in place.
* Performs comprehensive risk audits with actionable insights for improving application and infrastructure security.
* Implements backup and disaster recovery strategies to ensure business continuity during security incidents.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in cyber threat detection, security operations, or incident response, including leading security investigations and team mentoring.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Cybersecurity or Network Security.
* Strong understanding of cyber attack methodologies, intrusion detection systems, network traffic analysis, and threat actor tactics.
* Hands-on experience in penetration testing, vulnerability scanning (e.g., Nessus, Qualys), and using tools like Splunk, Wireshark, and EDR solutions.
* Deep knowledge of system hardening, secure network architecture, and endpoint protection strategies.
* Proficiency in JIRA, Confluence, and working within Agile/Scrum environments with CI/CD integration.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
**Overview**
**About JAGGAER**
JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.
  
  
Our 1,300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products—ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.
  
  
For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com
  
  
**Cyber Security Analyst**
**The Role**
Reporting to the Manager, IR & Assurance, the Cyber Security Analyst is a core member of the JAGGAER Security Operations Centre (SOC). The analyst shares the day-to-day threat analytics, security event triage, investigation, and incident response that protect JAGGAER's corporate and production environments across on-premise and cloud systems.
  
  
This is a hands-on mid-level operational role. The analyst works as part of a small, close-knit team where everyone shares the core SOC responsibilities. As the analyst develops, they may take ownership of a specialism (for example threat intelligence, threat hunting, or incident response) at approximately 20% of their time, on top of the shared core. This role is based in Hyderabad, India, with hybrid working, and operates within standard working hours.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
**Core Responsibilities (Shared by All Analysts)**
The core SOC responsibilities are shared across the team. The analyst will:
  
  

* Alert triage — Triage and validate security escalations from CrowdStrike Falcon Complete (MDR) and internal sources, prioritising by severity and logging a clear outcome for each.
* Investigation — Investigate confirmed and suspected incidents to establish scope, impact, and root cause, using structured, evidence-based methodology.
* Incident response — Contain, respond to, and document security incidents in line with the Incident Response Procedure — isolating hosts, blocking indicators, and coordinating remediation.
* Correlation & hunting — Correlate activity across CrowdStrike NGSIEM, Observe and the endpoint tooling (CrowdStrike Falcon and Microsoft Defender), using Zscaler VPN data for IP and connection analysis, and hunt for anomalies not surfaced by automated detection (failed logons, privilege escalation, new admin accounts).
* Phishing response — Review and action user-reported phishing (including via PhishER), confirm remediation, and initiate takedowns of malicious domains and leaked credentials.
* Production alignment — Align SOC investigations with security-related production incidents to ensure no coverage gaps between operations and security.
* Detection support — Feed investigation findings, including false positives and coverage gaps, back to the team to inform detection tuning.
* Documentation — Maintain accurate, complete records in Jira and the IR record for all work, and complete daily operational checks and handover.

**Position Requirements**
**What You Will Bring**
**Essential**

* 3+ years' experience in, or closely related to, the cybersecurity field, with hands-on security operations experience.
* Understanding of Microsoft Windows and Linux/Unix system-level security controls.
* Understanding of common threat-actor techniques, malware behaviour, and persistence mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including alert triage, host investigation and response actions such as containment.
* Practical experience with SIEM platforms, including alert triage, event investigation, and documentation. CrowdStrike NGSIEM or comparable technology.
* Practical experience using AI tools to support security work, such as summarizing alerts, drafting queries or analyzing logs, with the judgement to verify output and to keep sensitive data out of unapproved tools in line with company policy.
* Structured, evidence-based investigation approach with clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to work as part of a close-knit team, sharing the core workload and supporting colleagues.

**Desirable**

* Experience with the MITRE ATT&CK framework and threat intelligence in operational practice.
* Familiarity with CrowdStrike NGSIEM, including CQL query writing, log ingestion concepts and detection rule structure.
* Experience working alongside a managed detection and response (MDR) provider.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender, Mimecast or phishing-response tooling such as KnowBe4 PhishER.
* Scripting (Python or PowerShell) to automate repetitive triage tasks.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (Azure, O365, AWS).
* Interest in developing a specialism (CTI, threat hunting, or IR).
* Relevant industry certifications held or in progress — for example CompTIA Security+, Blue Team Level 1 (BTL1), or ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC). Professional membership (ISC2, ISACA) is welcomed.
* Red/Blue team exposure.

**How You Will Grow**
The Cyber Security Analyst role sits on a clear progression path: Cyber Security Analyst → Senior Cyber Security Analyst → Lead Cyber Security Analyst, aligned to the NIST NICE and ENISA ECSF frameworks. Progression is evidence-based. Analysts are encouraged to develop a specialism as they grow, held as additional ownership alongside the shared core.
  
  
**What We Offer**
At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.
  
  
**Our Values - T.E.A.M**
At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.
  
  

* Transparency - Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* Entrepreneurial Spirit – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
* Accountability – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
* Metrics-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.

**Eeo**
JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration, and people come first.
  
  
We are proud to announce that
**JAGGAER has been certified as a Great Place to Work® for 2026**
, recognizing our commitment to creating an inclusive, empowering, and high-performing culture.

title: Senior Security Operations Centre Specialist
description:
**Our Global Structure**
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
  
  
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. Our Information Security team enables innovation at speed—securely. As digital guardians of DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, we safeguard our systems and the data of our employees, customers, riders, and partners. We defend against emerging cyber threats and embed security into every facet of the business. From building resilient defenses and responding to incidents to empowering teams with security knowledge, we are trusted partners protecting these global brands from the inside out.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Security Operations Centre Specialist offers a unique opportunity to shape our global Security Operations strategy across a global footprint of DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt. This role provides the platform to optimize our technology and AI investments while pioneering new methods to protect our data, people, and partners. As we expand, your specialist capabilities will be essential to our continued success.
  
  
What you’ll be doing
  
  

* Work in a 24/7 global security operations centre, including scheduled night and weekend shifts.
* Lead the triage and investigation of security alerts, including phishing, malware, network attacks, security hygiene and privacy related incidents within specified SLAs.
* Mentor a team of SOC Specialists, providing the necessary guidance and feedback to deliver a best-in-class security service to the business.
* Lead the development and continuously improve operational documentation, processes and playbooks
* Build and manage autonomous AI runbooks to automate and scale our alert triage capabilities.
* Lead incident response and escalation, ensuring lessons learned are translated into continuous security improvements.
* Support the design, development and review of threat-detection use-cases to identify suspicious activity across our cloud environment.

title: SOX ITGC Controls & SOX Key Reports
description:
**Job Description**
The Specialist role is a key member of the Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team within Cybersecurity and Digital Trust (CDT). The position is responsible for supporting Amgen's Information Technology Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Compliance program, with primary responsibilities across SOX IT General Controls (ITGCs) and SOX Key Reports.
  
  
The Specialist will partner with IT SOX Compliance leadership, system and service owners, engineers, developers, Finance, Compliance, Corporate Audit, and Internal and External Audit teams to support the design, execution, monitoring, validation, and continuous improvement of SOX IT controls and key reports.
  
  
The role requires a strong understanding of IT controls combined with the technical ability to analyze systems, applications, report logic, data flows, queries, and supporting technologies to ensure SOX controls and reports are appropriately designed, documented, operated, and supported.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
SOX ITGC Controls
  
  

* Support the execution and ongoing management of the ITGC SOX Controls and Compliance program.
* Coordinate and support quarterly and annual SOX certification activities with control owners, process owners, system owners, and other stakeholders.
* Review control documentation and supporting evidence to assess control execution, identify potential gaps, and ensure SOX requirements are appropriately addressed.
* Partner with control owners to strengthen control design, documentation, evidence quality, and operational effectiveness.
* Participate in SOX walkthroughs with system, service, process, and control owners.
* Support Internal and External Audit evidence requests, testing inquiries, walkthroughs, and remediation activities.
* Review SOX systems and applications within the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) to assess SOX applicability and ensure relevant system components and dependencies are appropriately identified.
* Assess IT audit findings, identify relevant mitigating controls, support root cause analysis, and coordinate remediation activities through completion.
* Support the design, implementation, and effectiveness of SAP GRC SOX ITGC controls, including Logical Access, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and Emergency Access.
* Support SAP GRC processes such as Access Request, Risk Analysis, Role Management, user access lifecycle activities, and Emergency Access.
* Support key access controls including role reviews, privileged access monitoring, access governance, and related issue remediation.
* Partner with IT Security, SAP Basis, application teams, and other technology stakeholders to ensure appropriate implementation and operation of controls across SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and integrated systems.
* Develop and maintain SOX guidance, procedures, training materials, and educational resources to support control and process owners.
* Promote compliance by design by partnering with IT teams to embed appropriate controls within technology processes and solutions.

SOX Key Reports Analysis & Validation
  
  

* Serve as a key contributor to the SOX Key Reports program for system-generated reports relied upon in the execution of SOX controls.
* Perform technical analysis of report logic, including application code, queries, scripts, calculations, configurations, data transformations, and report parameters.
* Validate the completeness and accuracy of SOX Key Reports by reconciling report outputs to source systems and underlying data.
* Review custom-developed and configurable report logic, including technologies such as SAP ABAP, SQL, ERP reporting tools, and other financial applications.
* Analyze and interpret technical artifacts including SQL queries, stored procedures, ETL logic, interfaces, application code, and data transformations.
* Recreate or independently generate report outputs, where applicable, using reviewed queries, application logic, or ERP report code to validate report accuracy.
* Perform report tie-outs between reports provided by Process Owners and independently generated outputs.
* Reconcile record counts, key data fields, financial totals, parameters, and reporting periods between source data and report outputs.
* Confirm report parameters, filters, date ranges, calculations, and report logic align with the intended SOX control objective.
* Verify whether manual manipulation or post-extraction adjustments have been applied to system-generated reports and assess their impact.
* Investigate and document variances identified during report validation and ensure explanations and resolutions are appropriately supported.
* Identify potential gaps, defects, or risks associated with report logic, data integrity, interfaces, system changes, or report generation.
* Support remediation and re-testing when key report logic, documentation, or report outputs do not meet SOX requirements.
* Partner with system owners, developers, Process Owners, Finance, Compliance, and Audit teams to understand report design, data flows, system dependencies, and control requirements.
* Ensure SOX Key Reports meet applicable documentation and testing expectations, including completeness, accuracy, access, and change management considerations.

Audit, Risk & Compliance Support
  
  

* Serve as a knowledgeable point of contact for Internal and External Audit inquiries related to ITGC controls and SOX Key Reports.
* Prepare and provide clear, complete, and timely audit evidence, technical explanations, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
* Participate in walkthroughs, audit testing, remediation discussions, and re-testing activities.
* Work with stakeholders to identify control or report deficiencies, evaluate associated risks, and drive issues through remediation.
* Ensure quality, completeness, and timeliness across assigned SOX and compliance deliverables.
* Maintain awareness of changing technology environments, implementation methodologies, regulatory expectations, and emerging technologies that may impact IT controls and compliance.
* Identify opportunities to improve and automate SOX compliance, control monitoring, evidence collection, report validation, and related processes.

**Technical Skills & Experience**

* Strong understanding of SOX IT General Controls, IT controls, control design, control testing, and audit principles.
* Experience supporting SOX compliance, IT audit, IT risk, Information Security controls, or technology control assurance.
* Experience working with ERP platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, Oracle, Workday, and/or PeopleSoft.
* Ability to review and understand queries, scripts, application logic, and report code; experience with SQL, SAP ABAP, Python, or similar technologies is preferred.
* Understanding of data flows, system interfaces, ETL processes, access controls, and change management.
* Experience with data analysis and reconciliation tools such as Alteryx, Python, Oracle SQL Developer, or similar technologies is preferred.
* Working knowledge of IT infrastructure, ITIL, SDLC, Agile, and/or DevOps methodologies.
* Experience with Governance, Risk and Compliance tools such as AuditBoard, SAP GRC, ServiceNow IRM, or similar platforms.
* Experience with financial systems or applications such as Anaplan and Model N is an advantage.
* Knowledge of Information Security and Information Governance principles and relevant industry frameworks and standards.
* Experience supporting Internal and External Audit teams, including experience communicating with external auditors.
* Financial controls, financial reporting, or Big Four IT Audit/SOX advisory experience is an advantage.

Key Competencies

**Industry-recognized certifications are preferred, including:**

title: Senior IGA Engineer
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an
**IGA Engineer**
to design, build, operate, and sustain the enterprise Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) platform that serves as the control plane for how identity and access are governed across the organization. This role is responsible for developing and enhancing IGA capabilities—connectors, workflows, roles, and integrations—while keeping the platform healthy, reliable, and audit-ready, and executing the SOX ITGC controls that make it a trusted, compliant system of record for access.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role spanning both build and run: configuring and developing new capabilities, integrating target systems, and enhancing governance workflows on one side, and sustaining platform health, change management, vendor-coordinated migrations, incident resolution, and control execution on the other. The engineer turns requirements into working configuration and code, keeps the platform available, and ensures every SOX-relevant activity is performed on schedule with complete, clean evidence. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on experience with an enterprise IGA platform (SailPoint, Saviynt, or equivalent) combined with strong ITGC/SOX discipline and an operations-and-audit mindset.
  
  
The IGA platform is a business-critical, SOX-scoped security capability. Operational lapses translate directly into two kinds of failure: disruptions that block provisioning, deprovisioning, and access reviews, and control failures that produce audit findings and compliance exposure. This position is critical to ensuring the platform is stable, well-instrumented, and rarely surprises the business.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**IGA Development & Engineering**

* Design, develop, and enhance IGA capabilities—connectors, integrations, joiner/mover/leaver (JML) and access-request workflows, roles, entitlements, certifications, and SoD rules—to meet evolving governance and business requirements.
* Build and maintain integrations between the IGA platform and target systems (HR, directories, cloud, and enterprise/SaaS applications) via APIs and connectors.
* Translate governance and access-model requirements into working configuration and code, following engineering standards and design patterns.
* Test, document, and promote changes through the appropriate environments with quality and maintainability in mind.

**Platform Operations**

* Operate, administer, and sustain the IGA platform so it runs reliably day to day, resolving sync, provisioning, and workflow failures as they arise.
* Execute platform upgrades, patches, and configuration changes through disciplined change control, with validated cutover and rollback plans.
* Maintain and enforce environment segregation between non-production and production.

**Observability, Monitoring & Reliability**

* Configure and continuously tune monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboards for the platform, its connectors, and its governance workflows.
* Establish leading-indicator alerting (connector health, provisioning failures, job/queue depth, workflow errors) so degradations are caught before they disrupt users.
* Ensure failures generate alerts and that recurring errors are escalated into incidents per defined procedures.
* Define and track availability and health metrics for the platform and its critical workflows.

**Incident & Problem Management**

* Investigate and resolve incidents affecting the IGA platform and its governance workflows, restoring service and following the incident management process.
* Perform root-cause analysis on recurring platform issues and implement durable preventive fixes.
* Maintain runbooks and operational documentation to support consistent incident handling.

**Change & Release Management**

* Execute changes through the standard change management process—documented change requests, testing, and appropriate business/IT approvals before production migration.
* Enforce segregation of duties between developers and operations on production migrations; ensure any developer activity in production is monitored, logged, and reviewed.
* Support periodic change reviews and emergency-change post-implementation reviews.

**Vendor & Migration Coordination**

* Serve as a technical point of contact for platform and managed-service vendors during upgrades, migrations, and platform changes.
* Plan and execute migration/upgrade cutovers—scheduling, pre-checks, validation testing, rollback plans, and go/no-go decisions—and hold vendors accountable to SLAs.
* Coordinate with infrastructure and cloud teams on environment or backup dependencies.

**SOX & ITGC Compliance Execution**

* Own timely, accurate execution and evidence collection for the IGA platform's SOX control set, working within the broader IAM SOX program's governance and cadence.
* Execute access-administration controls: provisioning and account changes, terminations/deactivations, administrative and user-account revalidations, SoD/role matrix maintenance, and privileged account activity reviews.
* Execute change-management controls in line with the segregation-of-duties requirements above, and support SOC 1/SOC 2 report review and periodic governance and risk reviews.
* Investigate exceptions, assess impact, document results, and drive deficiencies to remediation; ensure no self-review on any revalidation control.
* Operate in a continuous audit-ready posture and support internal and external audit requests with complete, on-time evidence.

**Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Use scripting to make configuration and control execution repeatable, reviewable, and auditable, reducing operational toil and tightening the loop between operations and evidence collection.
* Maintain knowledge continuity through documentation and runbooks so no single control or activity depends on one individual.

**Experience**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 5–7 years in IAM/IGA engineering and operations, with hands-on experience configuring and developing on an enterprise IGA platform.
* Proven experience building and operating an enterprise IGA platform in production (SailPoint, Saviynt, or comparable).

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on IGA development and administration: connectors/integrations, JML and access-request workflows, roles/entitlements, certifications, and SoD rules.
* Solid grounding in IAM fundamentals: authentication, SSO (SAML/OIDC), provisioning/SCIM, RBAC, JML, and SoD concepts.
* Experience building and integrating with target systems (HR, directories, cloud, and enterprise/SaaS applications) via APIs and connectors.
* Experience with observability and monitoring for application platforms—building meaningful alerts and dashboards, not just consuming them.
* Experience with incident and change management via ITSM tooling.
* Scripting ability (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation of platform tasks and evidence collection.

**Compliance Skills And Experience**

* SOX compliance and ITGC control testing experience.
* Ability to think, review, document, and challenge evidence from an auditor's perspective.
* Experience managing internal and external audit engagements.
* Strong understanding of IAM processes, access controls, and evidence validation.
* Ability to assess compliance risks and identify control gaps.
* Strong documentation and communication skills for auditor interactions and compliance reporting.
* Hands-on experience executing and evidencing core ITGC control types—access provisioning/deprovisioning, periodic user and privileged access reviews/recertification, and Segregation of Duties (SoD).
* Change-management control experience—change request tracking, testing, approvals, and dev-to-prod segregation of duties.
* Experience with deficiency and exception management—investigating exceptions, assessing impact, and tracking remediation to closure.
* Discipline to execute recurring controls on cadence and sustain audit-ready evidence.
* Experience reviewing SOC 1/SOC 2 reports, including complementary user entity controls (CUECs).
* Familiarity with GRC/compliance tooling for evidence and control management.
* Experience working with enterprise IAM platforms such as AD, SailPoint/Saviynt, etc. is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant IGA platform certification or equivalent platform-specific training.
* Deeper experience developing and troubleshooting IGA connectors and integrations.
* Experience leading IGA platform migrations or major version upgrades.
* Prior experience partnering with GRC, Internal Audit, and External Audit in a regulated enterprise.
* General awareness of the cloud environment the platform runs in—enough to coordinate effectively with infrastructure and vendor teams (deep cloud engineering not required).

Why This Role Is Critical
  
  
The IGA platform is where access is governed and where a significant set of SOX ITGC controls are executed. Without dedicated engineering, operational, and compliance ownership, the platform is exposed on two fronts at once: reliability and audit.
  
  
**This Role Directly Protects The Organization From**

* Platform and workflow disruptions that block onboarding, delay deprovisioning, and stall access reviews.
* SOX control failures and audit findings—missed revalidations, broken change/SoD discipline, incomplete evidence.
* Failed or delayed platform migrations and upgrades due to a lack of internal accountability.
* Incident-handling and control-coverage gaps that threaten compliance and continuity.
* Over-dependence on premium-priced vendor and contractor support.

This position is for an engineer who builds, runs, and keeps a business-critical, SOX-scoped platform effective—someone who understands that in a regulated identity platform, engineering, reliability, and compliance are the same job.

title: Application Engineer - III-ES and F33-P
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- Consulting- Risk**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication, and updating senior team members on progress
* Administer and support enterprise Okta environments across production, non-production, and disaster recovery tenants.
* Design, review, test, and implement Okta policies (Global Session Policies, Application Sign-in policies, authenticator enrollment policies etc.,)
* Engineer secure authentication experience using SSO, MFA, passwordless and phishing-resistant authenticators, while balancing security, user experience, and business continuity,
* Configure and troubleshoot application integrations using SAML 2.0, OIDC/Oauth 2.0, SWA, WS-Federation, and SCIM, including claims, assignments, provisioning, and deprovisioning.
* Develop and maintain Okta workflows and API-based automations for identity operations, policy administration, notifications, reporting, and bulk changes.
* Monitor authentication health and security events using Okta system lo and Splunk dashboards/alerts. Analyse trends, investigate anomalies, and recommend threshold or control improvements.
* Provide operational support for authentication incidents and service requests, preform root cause analysis, coordinate vendor support, and document resolution and closure evidence.
* Plan and execute controlled IAM changes, including impact analysis, implementation steps, risk assessment, test cases, success criteria, communications, rollback plans, and post change validations.
* Maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, runbooks, implementation plans, architecture notes, and support procedures in approved enterprise repositories.
* Create and manage Jira stories and sprint deliverables, estimate work, track dependencies, communicate progress, and support Agile ceremonies.
* Collaborate with IAM engineering, IAM operations, application owners, directory services, service desk, security operations, infrastructure teams, change management, and product vendors.
* Contribute to knowledge transfer, onboarding, peer reviews, mentoring, and continuous improvement of team standards and operating procedures.
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong hands-on experience in okta administration, with the ability to translate business and security requirements into supportable technical configurations.
* Deep understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, including SSO, MFA, passwordless authentication, phishing resistance, session management, and adaptive or risk-based access.
* Practical experience with Okta policies, rules, groups, profile mappings, authenticators, application assignments, directory integrations, user lifecycle management, and role-based administration.
* Working knowledge of SAML 2.0, Oauth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SWA, WS-Federation, SCIM, REST APIs, JSON, XML, and HTTP concepts.
* Experience in designing, testing, and troubleshooting provisioning and deprovisioning flows, group-based access, profile sourcing, attribute mappings, and downstream application behavior.
* Ability to use Splunk and Okta system log for operational monitoring, alert analysis, incident investigation, change validation, and audit evidence.
* Understanding of access-control models such as RBAC and ABAC, least privilege, privileged access, break-glass access, identity governance, and security control design.
* Good understanding of Access Management, Workforce and CIAM solutions.
* Strong Understanding of Okta API’s and good understanding of XML, HTML, CSS.
* Should be capable of dissecting large problems and designing modular, scalable solutions.
* Knowledge on FIDO, OAuth, Open ID connect and REST Concepts.
* Hands-on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Hands-on experience on configuring the tool as per the requirements.
* Hands-on experience on Directory level integration with Okta for AD, LDAP, Azure AD, Oracle AD.
* Good Understanding on IWA and Okta Workflows.
* Hands-on experience on Okta APIs.
* Should be knowledge on Okta Access Gateway, Okta Advance Server Access and SCIM.
* Define and set up approach for risk-based MFA and applications access control.
* Hands-on experience on security related assessments and configuration for AM platforms, adaptive risk configurations and Multi-factor authentications.
* Capability of understanding the business requirements and converting that into design.
* Ability to perform risk assessment and threat modelling exercises with technology engineering teams.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Worked in client facing role.
* Experience with ServiceNow, JIRA, Confluence, Bruno or Postman, Git-based version control, and enterprise change management processes.
* Need to be thorough in their respective tool with hands-on experience involving configuration, implementation & customization.
* Hands-on Java/Python development and debugging experience.
* Use case design, Solution Requirements Specification and mapping business requirements to technical requirements (Traceability Matrix).
* Involvement in a successful pursuit of a potential client by being part of the RFP response team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* 5-9 Years’ Work Experience in Identity and Access Management
* Experience implementing or supporting SSO, MFA, directory integrations, federation, lifecycle management, and application onboarding.
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Experience Access Management tools such as Okta, PingFed
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Ability to participate in client-facing discussions and work effectively across on-site and offshore delivery models.

**Certification:**

* Okta certifications such as Okta Certified Professional, Administrator, Consultant, Developer, Workflows speciality.
* Security certifications such as CISSP, CISA, or an equivalent IAM/security certification.

**What We Look For**

* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.
* A structured problem solver who can break down complex authentication issues, validate assumptions with evidence, and drive issues to closure.
* A dependable team member who takes ownership, communicates early, documents clearly, and collaborates effectively across technical and business teams.
* A continuous learner who keeps pace with IAM threats, product changes, modern authentication standards, and automation opportunities.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
The Business Management and Controls organization enables business delivery on all GT functions including strategy, AIT Management, workspace management, workforce governance, employee engagement, risk management, application security and vulnerability assessments, portfolio governance and integrated reporting. Additionally the team also provides support on enhanced approvals for resource requisitions, campus hiring program and global mobility.
  
  
**Job Description\***
.
  
  
This role reviews high‑risk security exceptions such as access to blocked websites, proxy or IAM control bypasses, and SSL inspection exclusions. The role assesses business need versus security risk, understands architecture, network and SDLC flows, ensures proper compensating controls, partners with security and risk teams, maintains audit‑ready documentation, tracks trends, and supports informed, time‑bound risk decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***
Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Review and assess high‑risk security and access exceptions, including:

+ Access to critical or high‑risk blocked websites
+ Proxy authentication bypass requests
+ IAM control deviations (authentication, authorization, MFA, service identities)
+ SSL/TLS content inspection exclusions

* Perform end‑to‑end risk analysis by evaluating architectural flows, network paths, identity boundaries, and trust relationships

* Partner with GIS, Software owners, Application teams, Network engineering teams, and Risk stakeholders to ensure informed decision‑making
* Apply SDLC and environment awareness (DEV, SIT, UAT, PROD) when evaluating risk tolerance and enforcement expectations
* Drive remediation plans or architectural fixes to reduce reliance on repeated or long‑term exceptions
* Track and facilitate closure or renewal of exceptions with defined ownership, rationale, and expiry timelines
* Identify portfolio‑level trends and systemic risks, such as recurring control bypasses or accumulating residual risk
* Publish and maintain risk dashboards and management metrics (exception aging, high‑risk exposure, control gaps)
* Ensure all exception decisions are audit‑ready, well‑documented, and compliant with AIT and enterprise security standards

**Requirements**

* Any Graduation / Post Graduation

* Risk‑sensitive mindset with the ability to identify, escalate, and document high‑impact security risks

title: AI GRC Specialist
description:
About Us – Who We Are

ProductSquads was founded with a bold mission: to engineer capital efficiency through autonomous AI agents, exceptional engineering, and real-time decision intelligence.

We're building an AI-native platform that redefines how software teams deliver value — whether through code written by humans, agents, or both. Our technology stack combines agentic AI systems, ML pipelines, and high-performance engineering workflows.

This is your chance to build not just models, but systems that think, decide, and act — AI fabric tools, domain-intelligent agents, and real-time decision systems that power the next generation of product delivery.

The Role – What You'll Do

Role Purpose

Own trust assurance workflows from intake through decision and closure. The AI GRC Specialist delivers accurate customer security questionnaire responses, coordinates security contributions to RFPs, reviews security content in customer addendums, runs vendor risk assessments, maintains the company risk register, and leads at least one certification workstream.

The role uses AI to improve the complete GRC workflow, not simply to process more requests. It applies the time saved to risk analysis, vendor follow-through, and certification closure. The Specialist makes clear, business-focused recommendations and works with limited day-to-day supervision.

Role at a Glance

* **Function:**
  Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) / Security Assurance
* **Level:**
  Individual Contributor
* **Experience:**
  8+ years of relevant experience
* **Reports To:**
  CISO or designated security leader
* **Core Scope:**
  Customer assurance, vendor risk, risk register, certification workstream, and AI-assisted GRC improvement

Responsibilities – Your Scope

1. Customer and Sales Assurance

* Own security questionnaire delivery from intake to submission, including prioritization, customer follow-up, service levels, and answer quality.
* Coordinate security responses and evidence for RFPs owned by Sales or the business team. The Specialist does not own the overall RFP.
* Review and respond to security and risk provisions in customer addendums. Engage Legal for contractual terms outside the security scope.
* Maintain the security answer library and verify that standard answers reflect current controls and evidence.

2. Vendor Risk and Risk Register

* Run the vendor risk program, including tiering, due diligence, assessments, risk ratings, remediation tracking, and reassessment cadence.
* Lead assessments for high-risk vendors and coordinate evidence or action plans with relevant internal owners.
* Maintain the risk register in the company GRC platform by documenting risks, assigning owners, tracking treatment, and providing leadership with a current view of the organization's risk posture.

3. Certifications and Control Assurance

* Own at least one certification workstream, such as SOC 2, ISO 42001, or TISAX, from gap assessment through auditor closure. Support other assurance activities as needed.
* Coordinate control owners, evidence collection, remediation, and audit follow-up while keeping status and dependencies visible.

4. AI-Assisted GRC Operations

* Improve workflows for questionnaire drafting, vendor document review, control mapping, and evidence reuse, with feedback loops that make subsequent cycles more accurate.
* Measure changes in manual effort and answer accuracy, and demonstrate how the capacity released is redirected to risk analysis and closure activities.
* Coach Analysts on quality, escalation, and identifying manual steps that can be simplified or automated.

What This Role Is Not

* A questionnaire-processing role measured by volume alone; accuracy, risk insight, and closure matter.
* The owner of end-to-end RFP delivery; the role provides security content and supporting evidence.
* A legal reviewer or the final decision-maker for accepting company risk.
* A security engineering role. Engineers build and enforce technical controls; this role verifies evidence, tracks gaps, and escalates issues where controls are not operating as expected.
* A gatekeeper that slows sales or procurement. The role balances timely responses with reliable, supportable answers.

Ownership – Decision Rights and Deliverables

Decision Rights

**Decides / Owns**

* Questionnaire workflow, answer-library maintenance, assessment execution, and risk-register quality.
* Vendor tiering and reassessment cadence within approved policy.
* GRC workflow improvements and quality checks within approved tools and policies.

**Recommends / Coordinates**

* Security response positions and remediation plans with control owners.
* Certification workstream priorities and closure plans.
* Use of AI-assisted drafting and review, with appropriate validation.

**Escalates / Consults**

* Risk acceptance to the designated business or risk owner.
* Contract language outside the security scope to Legal.
* Technical control design or implementation gaps to Security Engineering or relevant control owners.

Key Deliverables

**For Each Request**

* Accurate, evidence-backed customer questionnaire or security contribution delivered within the agreed service level.

**Ongoing**

* Current vendor assessments, tiering, remediation actions, and reassessment dates, with active follow-up on high-risk vendors.
* A current risk register with documented ratings, accountable owners, treatment status, and a concise leadership risk-posture view.

**At Certification Milestones**

* A defined certification workstream with gap status, evidence owners, remediation tracking, and auditor actions tracked through closure.

**Quarterly Review**

* AI-assisted GRC workflow metrics covering effort, answer accuracy, cycle time, and how released capacity was utilized.

Requirements – What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 4 years of experience in GRC, security assurance, or vendor risk, including hands-on ownership of customer questionnaires and vendor assessments.
* Experience supporting SOC 2 and at least one of ISO 27001, ISO 42001, or TISAX.
* Demonstrated use of AI-assisted tools to reduce manual work while improving accuracy, with appropriate human review.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain risk and business impact to customers and senior stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Experience administering a GRC platform such as Secureframe, Vanta, or Drata.
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and AI-specific vendor risk.
* CISA, CRISC, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer certification. Relevant practical experience is also valued.

Leadership Competencies

* **Risk Judgment:**
  Separates control evidence, exposure, and business impact, and makes proportionate recommendations.
* **Accuracy and Ownership:**
  Checks source evidence, closes follow-ups, and keeps records current.
* **Clear Communication:**
  Writes concise, supportable responses and adapts the level of detail to the audience.
* **Responsible AI Use:**
  Validates generated content, protects sensitive information, and understands when human review or escalation is required.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Identifies recurring workflow challenges and measures whether changes improve both efficiency and quality.

How Success Is Measured

Success is measured through service-level performance, response accuracy, timely completion of vendor assessments, a current and actionable risk register, certification milestones achieved, and reduced manual effort without weakening risk management.

Request volume alone is not a measure of success.

What We Offer

* Monday to Friday workweek with flexible working hours
* Paid time off and holidays
* Medical insurance
* Professional development and training budget
* A dynamic, collaborative, ship-fast environment

title: Principal Engineer Software
description:

* Write clean, highly secure, and performance-optimized code for critical authentication paths and build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to evaluate new architectures.

* Drive engineering modernizations, including upgrading backend frameworks, implementing secure CI/CD pipelines, and integrating advanced security analysis tools.
* Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of critical bugs involving multi-tenant SSO setups, token encryption/signing, and token lifecycles.

* Conduct rigorous reviews of complex protocol implementations and cryptographic designs to ensure strict adherence to RFC standards.
* Proactively identify and resolve cross-team technical dependencies for seamless integration.
* Teach, guide, and upskill developers, fostering a culture of deep identity security awareness.
* Represent the company in the cybersecurity industry by speaking at tech conferences, writing technical blogs, or contributing to open-source identity standards.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record in a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer role.

* Exposure or strong interest in applying AI/ML technologies within cybersecurity contexts.
* Strong background in modern cloud-native architectures, distributed microservices, and secure-by-design engineering principles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience in public speaking, technical writing (blogs/whitepapers), or mentoring engineering communities.
* Broad understanding of the business context, connecting technical decisions to customer value.
* Ability to translate highly complex technical concepts for both engineering and business stakeholders.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) architectures, specifically building and securing SAML 2.0 Identity/Service Providers and OAuth 2.0/OIDC Authorization Servers.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

* Core Technical Skills
* Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform for multi-cloud Infrastructure as Code.

* Strong CI/CD skills — designing and building end-to-end pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) with automated testing, security gates, and deployment strategies (blue-green, canary, rolling).

title: Senior IT Auditor
description:
**Who We Are**
Tronox is the world’s leading vertically integrated manufacturer of titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigment and other materials that add brightness and durability to products you encounter every day. We are 6,500 people strong, located across 12 countries and unified by a strong set of values that guide us in our work. At our mines and manufacturing plants, labs and offices, we responsibly transform the earth’s resources into products and opportunities that enhance lives. Our vision is to shape a sustainable, thriving world through enriched and refined minerals.
  
  
**The Role**
This is an opportunity to join a
**global organisation and work on a broad range of technology, controls and audit activities across an international business**
.
  
  
You will work with colleagues across multiple functions and time zones, gaining exposure to global systems, processes and stakeholders while continuing to develop your technical and business knowledge.
  
  
The role is available remotely, with flexibility and proactive communication essential to working effectively across our global teams.
  
  
Reporting to the
**Senior Manager, IT Audit**
, you will be part of a global internal audit team, working closely with colleagues across Tronox, application and technology teams, governance functions and our external auditors.
  
  
You will play a key role in delivering global IT internal controls testing, with a particular focus on SAP environments, IT general controls, automated controls, key reports and system configurations.
  
  
While the role has a strong IT audit focus, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to business controls testing, operational audits, data analytics, compliance investigations and other specialist projects.
  
  
We are looking for someone who is analytical, methodical, proactive and keen to learn and develop, with the ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with colleagues across different functions, locations and time zones.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Perform IT general controls testing, including evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of controls and identifying potential risks.
* Conduct SOX testing across global IT systems and applications.
* Review and test automated controls, key reports and system configurations.
* Perform business process and business controls testing.
* Work with key stakeholders and external auditors to support an effective and streamlined controls environment.

* Monitor and test the remediation of identified control deficiencies.

* Communicate complex technical issues clearly and effectively to a range of stakeholders.
* Proactively manage priorities, escalate issues appropriately and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines.

**About You**
We are looking for someone who is
**logical, methodical, organised and analytical**

Global / Flexible Location

title: Network Operations Center Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**

The
**GNOC Engineer**
is responsible for monitoring the organization's global network and infrastructure environment, identifying and responding to alerts and incidents, performing initial troubleshooting, and coordinating escalations with network, infrastructure, security, and other technical teams. The role requires strong operational discipline, communication, and the ability to work effectively in a
**24x5 shift**
environment with the potential to support a future 24x7 model.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Monitor network, infrastructure, connectivity, and service health using enterprise monitoring and management tools.

• Identify, validate, prioritize, and respond to alerts and incidents in accordance with defined SLAs and operational procedures.

• Perform
**Level 1/Level 2**
troubleshooting for
**network connectivity, WAN/LAN, VPN, wireless, firewall**
, and infrastructure-related issues.

• Create, update, and maintain incident and service tickets with accurate troubleshooting details and timelines.

• Escalate incidents to Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Service Desk, vendors, or other resolver groups when required.

• Follow established SOPs, runbooks, escalation procedures, and change-management processes.

• Perform proactive monitoring and identify recurring alerts, trends, and potential service-impacting issues.

• Support incident bridges and major incident activities, including timely communication and escalation.

• Coordinate with global teams and vendors during outages, maintenance windows, and service-impacting events.

• Maintain shift handover documentation and ensure clear communication of open incidents, risks, and follow-up actions.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including alert tuning, automation, documentation, and operational process improvements.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

•
**2+ years**
of experience in
**NOC, GNOC, network operations, infrastructure operations**
, or a similar technical operations role.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals:
**TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPN, and WAN connectivity.**

• Experience with network/infrastructure monitoring tools and ticketing platforms.

• Ability to troubleshoot incidents methodically using logs, monitoring data, connectivity tests, and documented procedures.

• Good understanding of incident, problem, and change management concepts.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly for incident escalation and shift handovers.

• Ability to work independently in a shift-based, 24x5 operational environment.

• Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize multiple alerts and incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

• Experience with tools such as
**SolarWinds, PRTG, LogicMonitor, Datadog, Splunk, ServiceNow**
, or equivalent platforms.

• Exposure to
**Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto, Aruba, Meraki,**
or similar networking technologies.

• ITIL Foundation or equivalent operational knowledge.

• Networking certification such as CCNA or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Exposure to cloud networking, SD-WAN, SASE, or automation is a plus. What Success Looks Like

• Consistent monitoring and timely response to alerts and incidents.

• Meeting operational SLAs and escalation timelines.

• Accurate ticket documentation and effective shift handovers.

• Reduction of recurring alerts through proactive investigation and improvement.

• Strong collaboration with global resolver teams.

• Contributing to automation, standardisation, and readiness for future 24x7 operations.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a technically strong and dependable operations professional who can remain calm during outages, think through real-world scenarios, communicate clearly, and take ownership from initial alert through resolution or escalation. The ideal candidate should demonstrate practical troubleshooting ability rather than relying only on theoretical knowledge.

title: Cloud Operations Analyst
description:
**Are you ready to shape the future of data?**

  

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

  

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.

  

We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.

  

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.

We're Matillion - and we're building the first AI Data Automation platform. Our cloud infrastructure isn't a back-office function; it's the engine that powers everything our customers rely on. As a Cloud Operations Analyst, you'll be a key architect of that engine, owning the reliability, scalability and security of our cloud-native platforms across AWS, GCP and Azure. This is a high-impact individual contributor role that sits at the intersection of Cloud Infrastructure, FinOps and SRE, and you'll be working in a small, focused engineering team where your decisions have real, visible consequence.

You'll be proactively identifying bottlenecks, driving automated remediation, applying AI tooling to accelerate workflows and partnering with Finance to make sure we scale efficiently. title: Zscaler Engineer (Available to join in 0-30 days)
description:
**Job Description: Zscaler Engineer**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a skilled
**Network Security Engineer**
with a strong focus on
**Zscaler**
technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for managing, configuring, and optimizing our secure cloud transformation and network security infrastructure.
  
  
This is a
**Hybrid**
role. Candidates must be located in or willing to relocate to one of our office hubs.
  
  
**Key Information**

* Total Experience: 5 to 7 years in Network Security
* Zscaler Experience: 2 to 3 years of dedicated, hands-on experience (Mandatory)
* Job Type: Hybrid
* Locations: Pune, Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, Kolkata, Hyderabad
* Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days max

**Key Responsibilities**

* Zscaler Management: Handle the deployment, configuration, policy administration, and troubleshooting of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA).
* Traffic Redirection & Engineering: Manage and maintain Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) deployments, PAC files, and traffic redirection methods (GRE/IPSec tunnels).
* Security Policy Administration: Configure and monitor URL filtering, SSL inspection, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) policies.
* Network Security Operations: Support traditional network security controls including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), intrusion prevention systems (IPS), and secure web gateways.
* Operations & Troubleshooting: Serve as the escalation point for complex network security issues, utilizing packet capture tools (Wireshark) to diagnose connectivity and performance anomalies.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the infrastructure and network teams to ensure smooth integration of Zscaler with SD-WAN and cloud environments (AWS/Azure).

**Required Skills & QualificationsZscaler Expertise (Mandatory)**

* 2–3 years of direct experience with ZIA (Cloud Firewall, Sandbox, Native SSL decryption).
* 2–3 years of direct experience with ZPA (App Connectors, Access Policies, User Portals).
* Proven experience troubleshooting Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) issues on Windows, macOS, or Linux.

**Core Network Security & Networking**

* Production experience with at least one major firewall platform (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point).
* Solid understanding of core routing and switching concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, OSPF, SD-WAN).
* Good grasp of standard authentication protocols (SAML, Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) as they integrate with Zscaler.

**Logistical Requirements**

* Must be available to join immediately or within a 30-day notice period.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA) or Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP).
* Certification in firewall technologies (e.g., PCNSE, NSE 4).
* CCNA/CCNP Security.

**What We Offer**

* Hybrid work flexibility balancing collaborative in-office days with focused remote work.
* Direct exposure to enterprise-scale cloud security migrations.
* Competitive compensation and clear technical career progression.

As digital guardians of DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, we safeguard our systems and the data of our employees, customers, riders, and partners. We defend against emerging cyber threats and embed security into every facet of the business. From building resilient defenses and responding to incidents to empowering teams with security knowledge, we are trusted partners protecting these global brands from the inside out.

This role provides the platform to optimize our technology and AI investments while pioneering new methods to protect our data, people, and partners. * Serve as the primary point of contact for medium-to-high severity alerts, providing tactical direction and escalating as required.
* Contribute to security playbooks and assist in developing AI-driven runbooks for automated alert triage.
* Support wider security incident investigations involving Threat Intelligence and Incident Response & Digital Forensics stakeholders.
* Assist in developing SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response) workflows to streamline incident handling.
* Collaborate with the team to develop and help deliver cybersecurity awareness programs for employees, emphasising incident reporting and best practices.

* 4–6 years of experience in a SOC environment, successfully resolving high-priority security alerts by identifying the root cause.
* Supporting the optimization of detection logic as a technical lead.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience as part of a Security Operations Centre, using monitoring platforms and triaging real-time alerts.
* Hands-on experience with AWS security config, SOAR, GSO, EDR/XDR, Splunk and SQL queries.
* Proven knowledge of optimal cloud security configurations, particularly across AWS
